name: Desktop Duck
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Dutch, Greek, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Ukrainian, Portuguese - Portugal
short: Your desktop deserves a duck. It lives on your screen, perches on your windows, and reacts to you. Earn hats together, then trade, sell, or show them off.
about: Meet your new desktop companion  Desktop Duck is a lightweight virtual pet that lives right on your screen. It doesn't sit in a window waiting for you. It wanders your desktop, hops onto your windows, naps on the taskbar, and notices what you're up to.    It has a life of its own     Reacts to you.  Type and it gets busy with you. Go quiet and it finds its own fun.     Keeps itself busy.  It reads a book, plays with a virtual pet, bounces a ball, juggles a soccer ball, or just sneezes.     Has feelings about its toys.  Take one away and you'll hear about it.     Loves attention.  Pet it, pick it up, toss it across the screen, and set it down wherever you want its home to be.                Dress it up  Your duck brings you gifts as you spend time together. Unwrap hats and glasses, fill out your Collection, and turn duplicates into Feathers to spend on the pieces you're after. Every item is a real Steam item you can trade with friends.            A companion that also helps you focus     Focus Mode.  Start a session and your duck settles down and keeps you company quietly until you're done.     Website Blocking.  Tell your duck which sites to keep you off, and it will fly over and close the tab for you.       Screen time stats.  See where your day went, without the guilt trip.                Bring your friends' ducks over  Join friends online and their ducks show up on your desktop beside yours. Chat, send emotes, and watch them waddle around together.                  Made to stay out of your way  Desktop Duck is light on your PC and never covers your full-screen games. Your activity stays on your computer, and all you need is Steam.

about: Tiny Pasture is your charming little farm simulator that cozies up at the bottom of your screen, keeping you company while you work or study. In this game, you can buy adorable baby animals, grow them, and collect coins dropped from them once they’re all grown up to rake in some sweet profits and expand your pasture. When you improve yourself and have fun, your little critters will grow with you.  Unlock New Species  Rabbits, foxes, alpacas, birds... and even slimes and zombies? Before long, you'll have an entire animal army!          Get Interactive with Your Animals  Feed them, click on them, and watch them grow happily! You can also click on them with the middle mouse button to make them follow your cursor around!          Raise a New Life  Place the Mystery Curtain in the Pasture and choose two adult animals of the same species. After a while, they'll breed and bring forth newborn animals!          Magic Pasture  Purchase and deploy magical facilities to help you keep your animals clean and healthy!           Other features  Freely drag and adjust the length of the pasture. Place it anywhere on your screen!          🖊️Game FAQ   Q:   I usually hide my taskbar, but after running the game, it's gone!    A:  Just press the Win key on your keyboard after running the game, and the taskbar will reappear.     Q:   Why is the background behind my animals black when I open the game?    A:  Please click on "View Discussions" on the store page; we've pinned a solution for the black screen issue there!     Q:   Whenever Steam pops up a notification, the Pasture screen tears!    A:  You can go to your library, right-click on our game, go to properties, general, and turn off "Enable Steam Overlay while in-game". This option will only affect our game and won't impact other games!

Watch as they live out their own lives:   My Little Life is built to be non-intrusive, with no loud popups or distracting events that need to be acted on immediately. name: Infi-Knight
lang: English**
short: A dark fantasy desktop-companion incremental that idles while you work, play, or browse. Play as a Knight cursed with immortality locked in endless battle against the undead. Grow stronger with every death, uncover the curses' secrets and the Knight's dark past, then break the cycle of undeath.
about: A dark fantasy, desktop-companion incremental idle game about a Knight cursed with immortality.  The Knight clashes against endless waves of undead, but for what? The memories, the reasons, The Order they swore themselves to, all faded to dust long ago. Now they simply fight, die, and rise. Again, and again, and again.  Yet, the fleeting flames of Remembrance have begun to spark. Unravel the mystery of the Knight's immortality curse, piece together a tattered past, and perhaps grant them the chance to break the Cycle of Undeath once and for all.   A endless battle against the undead in the corner of your screen   Infi-Knight lives in a resizable, movable window beside your other tasks. Look over to tithe your Gold, swap a Weapon, ignite a surge of  Zeal , or unlock what the Knight has remembered in the  Memory  codex.           Death rejects you   The Knight has one hit point and has been curse-bound to never truly die. Sooner or later, the horde   will   reach them. The Knight will fall, and rise, and fight again.  However ,   nothing is lost   when the Knight dies: every coin and every XP orb gained from the undead contributes to the Knight's growing power.  Immortality  is your punishment and  penance .            A worthy arsenal    Ten Weapons , each with their own way of unmaking the undead. A lane-clearing Halberd, a Holy Mace blessed by God, a full-field Arbalest, a burning Lance that sweeps across the horde, a massive Greatsword to cleave the graves, and more. Every kill contributes to that weapon's   Mastery  , a system that rewards sticking with a specific weapon to unlock passive upgrades with powerful  Tier 5  and  10    Capstone Perks   that  change the way each weapon plays .            Steadily grow your power   As The Knight stands against the undead, they collect  XP orbs  and gain up to  99   Levels    to fuel their baseline power and unlock  new gameplay  features.            Swear your Oath and gather lost Relics   Swear one of six   Oaths  , each a bargain to be weighed. Equip   Relics   that pair with your Weapon and Oath to create your very own build with which to stand against the endless undead.           Rekindle Memories to uncover your past   Reach milestones to reawaken your history as a Knight of  The Order.  With rekindled memories come new  Weapons ,  Relics ,  Lore  and more.             Gather Embers from Bosses   Pry valuable  Embers  from the bones of  Bosses . Then, spend them by performing   Last Rites   to gain permanent upgrades back at your  Camp .           Restore your Camp   Your hard-won  Embers  are consumed at  Camp,  which   provides you with   permanent meta-progression   that unlocks   new gameplay   elements and steadily improves your power.                A long incremental game with a Story Mode ending, and an unlockable Endless Mode.   Dozens of  Memories  across four acts, rekindled by your milestones and accomplishments. Piece together who the Knight was, the nature of their Immortality Curse, what their Order did, and why the dead will not remain buried.       A true desktop companion incremental idler. Resizable, borderless, option for always-on-top. Built to live beside your other tasks.     10 Weapons  with per-weapon  Mastery  ranks and  transformative   Capstone perks      14 Relics  to collect with build-changing passives     6   Oaths  to swear, each with an upside and downside to weigh    A  Camp  permanent meta-progression upgrade system     250 Levels  to attain     Dozens of   Memories  telling a four-act dark fantasy story in fragments     Dozens of hours  of gameplay    Unlockable  Infinite Mode      A global  Leaderboard  to rank each faithful Knight     An ending that may just solve the Immortality Curse       Capsule illustration credit -  Rodrigo Balmaceda

about: Let a quiet little cat keep you company while you work, study, and relax.    NoSlack Pets: Lo-Fi Paws  is a warm and cozy desktop cat companion game. Miino stays near the edge of your screen and quietly keeps you company while you type, study, work, or take a break. It does not interrupt your rhythm, but makes long focus sessions feel lighter, calmer, and more companionable.  You can start a Pomodoro, play Lo-Fi music or white noise, write down your to-do list, and place Miino on the edge of your desktop. You can also earn Gift Boxes while focusing or idling, collect Headgear and decorations, decorate Miino’s room, join the Online Study Room, go fishing to relax, and slowly build a cozy desktop space of your own.  • Focus and companionship turn into little rewards  Focus or idle for 30 minutes to earn a Gift Box, then open it for random Headgear. Headgear can be used to dress up Miino, used in Synthesis, recorded in your Collection, and some can also be listed on the Steam Community Market.          • Paw Coins build up slowly, helping you decorate Miino’s home  The Piggy bank keeps accumulating Paw Coins and XP, and you can claim them anytime. Use Paw Coins to buy houses, cat desks, and all kinds of decorations, then slowly build a comfy space for you and Miino.          • 448 Headgear pieces and 1500+ decoration items  If you enjoy collecting and DIY customization, there is plenty here to unlock over time.  The game currently includes  448 Headgear pieces  and  1500+ decoration items , covering cat outfits, cat homes, cat desks, room decorations, desktop devices, and many themed DIY elements. Mix and match different styles freely to create a relaxing space for Miino and its little home.  Create a warm study desk, a Lo-Fi work corner, a festive room, a cute cat nook, or a whimsical desktop world that feels entirely your own.          • Focus alone, or study together  When you want a gentle sense of company, join the Online Study Room.  Study, work, or idle alongside other players, and help each other open Gift Boxes. The Study Room is a quiet shared space: some players focus together, some collect together, and some slowly complete today’s small goals side by side.          • Let Miino live on your desktop  In Desktop Pet Mode, Miino can move to the edge of your desktop and keep you company while you type, work, or study.  You can drag it around, let it stay near the edge of a window, or watch it follow your cursor with its gaze. It blends into your desktop in a light, non-intrusive way, becoming a quiet little companion by your side.          • A gentler way to get into focus  Built-in Pomodoro, Lo-Fi music, white noise, to-do lists, and focus statistics help you start a focused session more easily.  Set a Pomodoro, play the background sounds you like, and write down what you want to do today. When you want to keep your desktop tidy, use the Cat Bus to tuck away small tools and open them again whenever you need them.          • Pool Party “grab” Gift Boxes  Use a mechanical claw in a laid-back poolside scene to grab Gift Boxes, receive random rewards, and collect little moments of joy.          • Fishing and light mini-games to change the pace  When you take a break, you can go fishing by the lake or play a quick mini-game. name: Sill Dogs
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Indonesian, Ukrainian, Dutch, Greek, Swedish, Spanish - Latin America, Thai, Czech, Danish, Turkish, Norwegian, Hungarian, Finnish, Bulgarian, Vietnamese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Polish, Malay, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean
short: Dogs walk around on your desktop. A dog is loyal to its owner — unlike a cat, it actually does as it's told. Put two out and they'll greet each other and play chase. A resident pet app with a free base version. Please take good care of them.
about: Sill Dogs is a resident desktop pet app where dogs live on your screen. Not inside a window — they walk directly across whatever you have open right now. The base app is free.     You can have up to two dogs on screen. With two of them out, they notice each other, come over, say hello, and start a game of chase. Enjoy watching them behave like real dogs.  Two dogs you get for free  The small, adorable Beagle (tricolor)  The big, dependable German Shepherd (black)     Paid DLC adds more breeds.    How they spend the day changes with the hour  Dogs are animals that fall in step with their owner's life. Their activity peaks in the morning and the evening, the daytime passes with short rests in between, and late at night they sleep soundly. They won't tear around at midnight the way a cat does. Now and then, though, a dog will break into a run at dawn or dusk for no reason at all.    They talk with their tails  A dog's feelings show in its tail. Wagging while sitting, wagging while lying down, wagging faster when excited, wagging hardest of all at a reunion. Even the same "tail wag" looks different depending on the moment.     Walking on your windows  Dogs use your open windows as footholds — walking along them, jumping down, climbing back up. Whatever state your desktop is in becomes their playground.     Staying out of your way  A desktop pet, however cute, gets removed the moment it gets in the way of your work. Sill Dogs lets you adjust the following in the settings.       Reaction to the cursor  /  Reaction to clicks  — each can be set to "Off / Weak / Normal / Strong".  The default is "Weak" .    Set it to "Off" and the dogs won't come over to your cursor while you're working    An option to keep the dogs off the front of a display while you're playing a full-screen game or watching a full-screen video    Dog size, which screen they appear on, and how many dogs (one or two)    You can move the dogs by dragging them      How to change the settings  Changing the breed, choosing which screen they appear on, quitting the app — all of it is done from the icon in the notification area (system tray), or from the bone sign.       Find the Sill Dogs icon in the Windows notification area and  right-click  it to open the menu    If you can't find the icon, click the "^" button at the bottom right of the screen to see the hidden icons    You can also open the settings screen from the "bone sign" on your screen.    From the menu you can choose "Breed selection", "Number of dogs", "Screen settings", "Auto-start settings", "Setting" and "Quit Sill Dogs"       About the DLC  Adding more breeds requires paid DLC.  There is a free toy DLC as well.  There is currently no feature for showing three or more dogs at once.  About the pixel art  The dogs' pixel art uses assets drawn by the pixel artist girlypixels.       Other  If you find a bug, reporting it on the Community Hub discussion board would be a great help.     Even if you live somewhere you can't keep a dog, even while you're working. Over in the corner of your screen, a dog is going about its usual day.  A link-up with our sister apps Sill Cats and Sill Sticks is in the works. It may take a little while.  Broadcasting policy  Anyone is free to stream this title or post videos of it, monetized or not. No prior permission or notification is required.     You don't have to tell us, but we'd be very happy if you did. A note on X (formerly Twitter) would be much appreciated — you can find our account from the store page. And if you include the store page URL in the description of your stream or video, we'd be delighted.     That said, please refrain from the following kinds of broadcasts. short: Petunia's Purgatory is a creepy-cute idle farming game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Grow cursed crops, feed the Elder God, and keep Petunia sane before her hallucinations invade your desktop.
about: Petunia’s Purgatory is a creepy-cute idle farming game that lives at the bottom of your screen.           Unlike passive idle games, your desktop becomes part of the experience as you grow cursed crops, summon unsettling helpers, prepare offerings for an Elder God, and keep Petunia sane before the hallucinations crawl beyond the farm.     Plant twisted crops, summon cute but creepy helpers, and attract mutated animals that provide blood for the harvest. Cook and craft raw produce into offerings for the ancient creature in your barn. Unlock and upgrade your helpers to keep the farm running while the Elder God waits for its next meal.             Cursed crops and blood-soaked offerings are rough on Petunia’s mind. Plant flowers and decorate the farm to maintain her sanity, but let it slip too far and hallucinations will begin to appear. Push the harvest too hard and Petunia may break. Neglect the farm, and something far worse may stir.              Streamers and viewers can build a farm together. Viewers can control what task their robot should focus on through chat commands like: !water, !harvest, !blood, !flower !crafter. Use !leave to stop.                                                                Petunia’s Purgatory. Cozy. Creepy. Always Watching.

about: Bring your favorite fluffy mommy straight to your desktop and keep her close while you work, browse the internet, or heroically pretend to be busy. Talk to her through your microphone - and she will answer in her own voice. Yes, exactly. Almost like the real mother. Almost.  She always stays on top of your other apps and games, so she’ll be right there whenever you need her. Chat with her about almost anything, ask for real-time help, listen to jokes, or simply enjoy a casual conversation. And if you suddenly start looking at her a little too often - no judgment.                                          Features     Always on Your Desktop     She stays on top of your apps and games. name: Poua! – Your Pomodoro Buddy & Minimal Desktop Timer
lang: English, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Brazil
short: Trying to focus but got distracted again today? What if a Pomodoro timer was watching you? You'd probably concentrate much better.
about: Meet Poua  There are too many fun things in the world. Notifications, pop-ups and more. Even at this moment, dozens of dopamine triggers are tempting you. Losing focus is not because your willpower is weak, but because your environment is too strong. That's why Poua has come to help you focus.  The power of a gaze          Poua looks your cursor. This is an intentional cue grounded in the "observer effect", the tendency for people to adjust behavior when they feel observed. That subtle sense of being watched can nudge you back on task and help reduce distractions.  Hear your goal, stay on track          When a session begins or your attention drifts, Poua can speak your preset goal and show it on screen. You control the frequency, and you can turn it on or off at any time.  Celebrate your progress          Earn points for dedicated focus and unlock surprise hat boxes. Dress up Poua with the hats you discover, and turn consistent effort into cheerful rewards.  Compete with Your Past Self          Challenge yesterday's you by racing against your own focus records. To deepen the immersion, you can revisit your past goals and even see the hats your past self was wearing. It's a friendly rivalry that keeps you motivated to stay consistent and outdo yourself day after day.  Stats!                Keep tabs on your focus journey with clear weekly and monthly statistics. Review your focus time, and consistency patterns to see how far you've come. These insights help you spot trends, celebrate milestones, and adjust your routine for better results.          Capture your thoughts without breaking focus  Poua's note feature lets you jot down ideas instantly without leaving your flow. It supports Markdown, Outliner structure, and quick reordering with Alt + Arrow keys. Adjust transparency to keep your workspace clear and focused.  A solid Pomodoro timer    You can set flexible session lengths down to the minute.    You can customize Focus, Short Break, and Long Break durations.    You can see clear visual progress and optionally show remaining time.    You can pause and resume sessions effortlessly.    You can run seamless automatic repeat cycles.    You can keep the widget always on top for quick glanceability.    You can adjust size and position to fit your workspace.    Thanks to its transparent background, it stays out of your way while you work.

name: Daily Botanica
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish
short: Daily Botanica is a relaxing desktop idler about raising mysterious plants. Pet and water each seedling, discover what makes it flourish, and arrange a living collection around your screen - even while you work, study, or step away.
about: A Garden That Lives on Your Desktop   Daily Botanica is a quiet plant-growing game made to share your screen, not take it over. Set down a pot, plant a mystery seed, and let a new companion grow beside your work, games, and everyday windows.   Nothing withers when you step away. A plant reaches full bloom in about a day on its own, while gentle care helps it grow sooner. Water the soil, brush the leaves with your cursor, or uncover a special ritual. Each successful interaction adds a lasting care bonus for that growth, making the plant grow faster while you carry on with your day.           Every Seed Is a Mystery   Every plant begins as an unknown sprout. As it develops through three growth stages, its silhouette, rarity, native habitat, variation, and identity gradually come into focus. The original collection contains 137 species, ranging from delicate familiar greenery to strange botanical treasures.            Each species has its own unusual preferences. Watch Botanica for clues and discover what your plant responds to: a gesture around its leaves, a moment of quiet company, or something brought over from your desktop. Special rituals can provide powerful care bonuses once per growth.           Keep What You Grow   When a plant reaches full bloom, harvest it into your Herbarium. Each specimen is its own individual, preserving its name, visual variation, care history, bond, and memories of the time you spent together.   Keep your favorites safely in the Herbarium, display them around your desktop, or send them to the Conservatory for additional XP. Displayed companions also earn a small amount of passive XP over time. Your Discoveries journal permanently records every species you have raised, even after an individual plant leaves your collection.  Follow the Garden Path   Harvesting plants, discovering new species, displaying companions, and sending specimens to the Conservatory earns XP. Progress through 100 Garden Levels, each with its own title and permanent reward.   Garden Levels unlock core pots, watering cans, additional growing spaces, and account-wide improvements such as shorter growth times, stronger care, faster interaction cooldowns, and increased XP rewards.  Make the Garden Yours   Arrange plants anywhere on screen and pair them with vessels from the Pot Atelier. Every growing space and displayed companion can be moved and resized independently. Growing spaces can be hidden without pausing their progress, while harvested plants can be displayed around your desktop without a fixed limit.   When you need a clear workspace, lock the garden and click straight through to the files, games, and windows beneath it. Daily Botanica stays present without getting in your way.           Grow at Your Own Pace   There are no failed crops, no wilting, and no penalty for closing the game. Growth and interaction cooldowns continue while you are away. Mystery seeds are always available, and new growing spaces open as your Garden Level rises.   A single pot can remain a small daily ritual—or become a garden spread across your entire desktop.  Features    137 species in the original collection   Three mysterious growth stages for every plant   Individual specimens with names, variations, bonds, and memories   A 100-level Garden Path with unique ranks and permanent rewards   Offline growth with no wilting or failed crops   Moveable, resizable, and hideable desktop plants   A click-through garden lock for an unobstructed workspace   Cosmetic vessels, watering cans, and growing spaces unlocked through Garden Levels

short: A small idle ARPG in a window at the edge of your desktop. The hero cuts through monsters and collects loot while you get on with your day. You only make the key calls: what to equip, what to sell, and which zone to take on next.
about: Let Hell Farm Itself  Desktop Hellfarmer is a small idle ARPG in a window on top of your desktop. The hero walks the zone, cuts down monsters and picks up loot without you. Meanwhile you work, watch videos or play something else, and come back when there is a decision to make.        Combat Without Buttons  You don't control the hero: it picks its own targets and hits everything around it. Whirlwind carries the hero through the crowd, Fire Cleave scorches the ground under enemies, and Seismic Leap stuns everyone nearby. Your part is choosing skills and spending the points each new level brings.        Loot Worth Looking Up For  Five gear slots, more than thirty item types and twenty random properties mean two identical finds are rare. Most of it gets sold, but now and then one of 14 legendaries drops with a special effect of its own. You see at once how a find compares with what you are wearing.        The Filter Sorts the Junk  The further you go, the less busywork there is. Filter rules sell what you don't need, and only items worth your attention reach Loot Review.        Gold Turns into Power  Gold goes into the Gold Tree: a hundred nodes across three branches for offense, survival, and loot with automation and offline progress. Once the build is ready, raise the difficulty: Normal, Nightmare, Hell, and ten permanent Agony ranks.        Five Zones and Their Masters  Rotten Fields, Old Cemetery, Sunken Crypt, Ashen Chapel and Black Pit. Each zone is its own map with ruins, graves, lava and obstacles, and a boss waits at the end in an arena of its own.        Lives on Your Desktop  The window stays on top, snaps to the edge of the screen and stays out of your way. In Transparency mode only the battlefield remains. And if you close the game, offline progress from the Gold Tree grants XP and Gold for the time you were away.

name: Townlet
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Finnish, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish
short: A tiny medieval village lives on top of your taskbar. Every file you delete falls from the sky, and its little villagers turn your digital trash into new ideas, buildings and festivals. Watch a lone campfire grow into a walled town while you work.
about: A village that lives on your desktop     Townlet is a tiny pixel-art village that lives in a thin strip just above your Windows taskbar. It only shows when your desktop does, never steals focus and never pops up notifications. Seven-pixel villagers chop wood, hammer at the forge, gossip in the square and head home when night falls, while you get on with your day.            Your trash is their treasure     Every time you delete a file, it drops into the village from the sky. The villagers carry it to the square, study it and turn it into knowledge. Pictures inspire artists, documents fill the scribe's shelves, music brings minstrels to town. Discoveries unlock new buildings, decorations and events, so no two villages grow the same way. Townlet never opens, moves or deletes your files. It only notices what kind of file landed in the Recycle Bin and how big it was. Nothing ever leaves your computer.                From campfire to walled town     Start with a single campfire and grow through village, town and city into a walled town with its own castle               Real seasons and a real day-night cycle: blossoms in spring, snow in winter, lantern light at night  Rain, storms, fog and starry skies                Markets, fairs, a town crier with the news, travelling minstrels and many small surprises             Pick up a villager and drop them somewhere else, just to see what they say              Decorate the village your way and design its banner              Keep a village ledger of your discoveries, history and the events you've seen  Take a picture of your village and share it     Calm by design     Nothing ever goes wrong in Townlet. No deaths, no famine, no fires, no lost progress. The village only ever grows. A soft seasonal soundtrack plays while your desktop is in view, and the village quietly fades out the moment you open a full-screen window.

name: Windowed Realms Demo
lang: Portuguese - Brazil, English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Czech, Hungarian, Polish
short: An idle kingdom builder and auto-battler that runs on your desktop while you work or relax. Hire pawns to gather resources, forge gear and send your army on expeditions that keep getting harder. Unlock skills, prestige to come back stronger and compete with other players on the leaderboard.
about: Windowed Realms  is an idle kingdom that lives in transparent windows on your desktop. The island, production, expeditions and leaderboard open in compact windows you can place anywhere, and your kingdom keeps growing while you work, study or watch something.    Pawns that gather for you          Hire up to 3 pawns. They roam the island chopping trees, breaking rocks and picking fruit. Every pawn you hire makes the island bigger and brings more resources. Each pawn has its own skill tree: attack, crits, speed, wood, ore or fruit specializations, and skills like Heavy Blow and Frenzy. Better tools unlock new materials on the island.    Auto-battle expeditions          Put together a party of warriors, archers and peons, equip each one with weapons and armor from Production and send them on an expedition. They fight on their own, room after room, against all kinds of enemies.    Bosses, skills and prestige          The further you go, the harder it gets, and every so often boss monsters block the way. Every class has a tiered skill tree. Hit the cap? Prestige: the class moves up a tier, unlocks new skills and comes back stronger to push even further.    Leaderboards and PvP          Compare your highest room with other players on the global leaderboard and put your army to the test in PvP duels.    Made to play while you use your PC    Transparent windows you can drag to any corner of the screen    The crystal ball minimizes the game, and your pawns keep working    Runs on its own: just check in every now and then      Add  Windowed Realms  to your wishlist and play the free demo.

name: MyBiz: Pomodoro Desk Tycoon
lang: English
short: A cozy pixel-art office sim powered by your real Pomodoros. Focus sessions earn cash + XP — decorate, hire staff, level up. Music, ambience, break-time minigames. Productivity tool by day, tycoon by every minute.
about: MyBiz — A Cozy Office, Run on Pomodoros   Build the most charming office on the block while you actually get work done. MyBiz is a desktop companion that turns your real focus sessions into in-game progress — every keystroke, every click, every Pomodoro funds a tiny pixel-art business that grows alongside your day.                How it works  Start a 25-minute Pomodoro and the office comes alive. Your typing fills a Keys bar, your clicks fill a Clicks bar, your music fills a Music bar — hit thresholds, earn cash and XP, level up, hire staff, expand to new floors. Take a break and the timer mode swaps to short or long break automatically. Skip out early? You still get prorated rewards.      Key features     Pomodoro that pays you back  — 25/5/15 cycles tracked across the day, with cash and XP rewards calibrated so a single focused session feels meaningful.      Build a working office  — buy desks, chairs, plants, lamps, recreation. Each piece of decor boosts staff output. Renovate floors (1F → 2F → 3F+), swap walls, doors, stairs, flooring.      Hire a team  — staff sit at their desks and add passive bonus rewards to every Pomodoro you run. Each one costs a daily salary though, so growing your office means balancing payroll against output. Watch them work while you work.     Keep them happy  — every staffer has a personal mood bar that slowly decays. Music, fresh decor, and shared coin grabs lift it back up. Happier teams output more — and play better at the foosball table on breaks      Customize your character  — hair, hat, top, bottom, shoes — earned or bought, swap anytime.              Tools that help you focus          Music player  — built-in playlist across Pop, R&B, Lo-fi, Jazz, Classic, Bossa, Funk. Auto-advance through the queue, loop the playlist, drop in your own tracks. Royalty-free tracks  (260 TRACKS!)  by talented independent artists.     Ambience mixer  — rain, forest, ocean, fireplace, wind, whatever puts you in the zone. Layer multiple sounds with individual volumes; resumes automatically next time you launch.      Quick tools  — sticky notes, a to-do list with  daily streaks , clipboard history, whiteboard scratchpad — all one click away.                Cozy minigames for breaks  When you need to step away from work without leaving the app: play  chess  against a built-in AI, beat your office in  foosball  or  flappy bird , jam on a  guitar  rhythm game, watch fish swim and  feed the aquarium , or just doodle on the  whiteboard .               Compact mode, Nano mode, and Monitor dock  Switch to the always-on-top mini window when you need the screen. Or attach the full window to the left or right edge of your monitor as a permanent productivity sidebar — your office, your timer, your stats, always glanceable.                Themes you unlock by working  Earn cash through Pomodoros and unlock 10 themes — solid palettes (Midnight Office, Forest Den, Cherry Blossom), gradient skies (Sunset Lobby, Ocean Tide, Aurora Borealis), and texture finishes (Paper Notebook, Wood Workshop, Marble Lounge). The whole UI re-skins instantly — buttons, backdrops, the office sky behind your sprites, even the mini window.                Track your milestones  25 achievements, from "First Day at Work" to "Pomodoro Empire" — natural progression rewards for first profit, first decor, focus streaks, click champions, and the long climb to level 12. Native Steam achievements with unlocked icons, all syncing to your profile.  Rare drops & a growing collection   Finish a focus session and a mystery box may drop on your office floor. Open it for a rare cosmetic or piece of furniture — 16 collectibles to hunt. Everything you find lives in your Inventory: equip cosmetics on your character, or place rare furniture around the office.  Step out into MyBiz Online  Need a change of scenery? Leave the office and wander a shared pixel-art park. Walk around with WASD, run into other players, chat MMO-style, and talk t

name: Artesnaut
lang: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean
short: A hardcore medieval fantasy idle RPG, almost entirely in text. Build characters with races, jobs, and epithets. Over 1,000 items to loot. A story 93% of players rated "great." Combat and exploration are fully auto—just check your results. Now in Chapter 5, unfolding across five major updates.
about: ■ About the Steam Version   Auto Repeat itself is available for free (base limit: 30 runs).  Optional purchases are not required and can further increase the Auto Repeat limit or improve expedition efficiency.  No ads are displayed in the Steam version.  Text size can be adjusted from 0.8x to 2.0x, and the window can be freely resized.   ◆ Artesnaut: Hardcore Idle Fantasy RPG   Experience a deep story of adventure with characters YOU create! Select from myriad jobs, races, and skills to build your perfect party!  A hack & slash idle RPG in a captivating fantasy world! Build a party of unique characters and conquer dungeons! Progress even when you can’t play! Start a quest and return later to reap the rewards and make the most of your time!  With classic, text-based gameplay, complete dungeons and unlock the next page of your epic adventure in Artesnaut!        ◆ Four Key Features    - Unique “Epithet” system gives characters their own unique personalities!   One of Artesnaut’s most standout features is its flexible character creation. Create a character by choosing a job and race, then create their epithet by selecting various adjectives (Blazing, Righteous, Fearless, etc.) and nouns (Contender, Alchemist, Executioner, etc.) to gain stat bonuses! Make a brutal attacker, hearty guardian, savvy treasure hunter, or whatever you want, then pit your perfect party against perilous dungeons!        - Diverse, intertwined narrative that captivated 93% of Japanese players!   New pages of Artesnaut’s story unfold as you progress through dungeons, then read those stories to unlock new dungeons  Main Story chapters chronicle the protagonists’ adventures, and interwoven Side Story chapters provide intriguing new perspectives to enrich the world. We hope you find yourself deeply immersed in Artesnaut’s authentic medieval fantasy world!        - A text-based, idle RPG! Dungeoneer during your downtime!   Exploration and battles occur automatically, and characters return after a set time. Watch events unfold in real-time, or see how your party fared afterward. Did your brave adventurers return with rare loot, or did the dungeon’s perils get the better of them?  Forge equipment, earn experience, and learn uncanny skills to grow your favorite characters as they venture into ever-deeper dungeons, teeming with evermore perilous foes! Engrossing character progression that is easy to enjoy!  Randomly generated loot means you can keep questing for the perfect gear! Strengthen and combine equipment to create items as legendary as your adventures.        - Deep lore in every dungeon and piece of loot breathes life into the world of Artesnaut!   Approximately 1000 pieces of equipment, each with their own story to tell! What is it? Why was it made? The answers to these questions take you deeper into the world of Artesnaut! Each dungeon is packed with lore as well, tying together the intricate narrative. Delving into dungeons may reveal short passages related to their origins. What you learn may give clues to help you on your adventure, or offer more context to characters’ stories.  We present to you a vast, detailed world, rife with text to discover and enjoy!       ------------------------------   Thanks to our amazing community, Artesnaut has celebrated its 7th anniversary and continues to grow with regular updates—new dungeons, equipment, jobs, and story chapters!       ------------------------------  ◇◆ Streaming & Video Policy ◆◇  ------------------------------  R.N.Studio welcomes streaming and video content of Artesnaut.  Both individuals and organizations are free to create and monetize content.    Please refrain from any use that would significantly harm the game's image.  We would appreciate it if you could include a link to the Steam store page in your description.

name: FarmWings
lang: English, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, French, German, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Russian, Spanish - Latin America, Indonesian, Polish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese
short: A vertical idle shmup: your fighter flies, dodges and shoots on its own, and you command its evolution. Beat adaptive AI bosses across 5 biomes and 3 difficulty modes, forge gear up to +10 and trade items on the Steam Community Market. Always in a corner of your screen.
about: Your fighter flies itself. The war is yours to win.   FarmWings is an idle game with arcade shmup combat (vertical shooter). The plane flies, dodges and shoots without you — your role is strategy: where the gold goes, which gear to use, where to farm and when to take on a harder difficulty.  ⚔️  4 fighters with unique weapons : the Blue Falcon (spread bursts) and the Black Raven (homing missiles) come with the game; the Scarlet Phoenix (laser) and the Golden Wasp (incendiary bombs) are optional DLCs.       🧠  Adaptive AI bosses : every biome has its own boss that reads your ship and reacts — it flanks the laser, avoids the fire zones, presses the missiles. After each special, a golden vulnerability window rewards attentive pilots.       🌍  5 biomes, 50 stages, 3 modes : Jungle, Ocean, Desert, City and Arctic, on Normal, Hardcore and Infernal. Moving up a mode wipes nothing: tree, gear and inventory come along.       🔧  Command Tree and Workshop : 90+ nodes bought with gold, gear in 7 rarities (Common to Relic), forging up to +10, dismantling and fusion.  💎  Treasure, missions and diamonds : bosses drop Treasure Clues, 3 daily missions pay Honor Medals, and rare diamonds pay for the last two forge levels.       🛒  Steam Community Market : send your Rare-or-better items to your Steam Inventory and trade with other pilots — 1 Honor Medal per item. Items stored there can be redeemed back into the game.  🏆  Achievements and in-game rankings : 18 Steam achievements, plus the game's own stage and best-item rankings.  🕹️  True idle : small always-on-top window, and earnings while the game is closed, unlocked in the tree.  An internet connection is required to play.   Available in 16 languages.

short: A tiny VPet device lives on your taskbar and its pixel pet hops with every key you press. Earn Bongo Points, catch a box or a key every 30 minutes of play, open boxes on a spinning reel and collect 140 devices from 7 series, pets, straps and charms you can trade on Steam.
about: A tiny VPet device lives on your desktop, and a pixel pet lives on its screen. Every key you press and every click you make earns a Bongo Point and makes your pet hop. Work, write, chat or play: your pet keeps you company while the points pile up. Type. Treat. Care. Every 250 presses a treat drops onto the screen. Feed your pet, check its mood, play the catch game, clean up after it and turn off the light at bedtime, all with the device's own three buttons. A content pet adds a 5% bonus to your points.        A box or a key every 30 minutes Every 30 minutes of play, a box and a key pop up beside your devices. Pick one for 1,000 Bongo Points: the key, or a box that spins in on its own reel. Every new player starts with a key.        Open it on the reel Put a key in a box and it bursts open on your desktop. The cards run past, slow down, crawl over the last few and stop on what you got. The odds stand right beside the reel before every opening. In a series box: Common 70%, Rare 22%, Epic 6%, Legendary 1.6%, Mythic 0.4%.               A Mythic find is announced to every player. 7 device series Classic, Tiny, Bat, Cat, Dino, Link and Rainbow: every series has 20 looks across five rarities and its own box. Rare looks come polished, metallic, holographic or glowing.        Pets, straps and charms The Pet Box holds 16 pets, each in the classic green LCD look and the rare Color look on a bright backlit screen. The Accessory Box holds straps and charms that swing from your device as you drag it around. Collect, trade, trade up Fill your BongoDex with 250 items. Everything is a Steam Inventory item: trade boxes and finds with friends or on the Steam Community Market. Duplicates are kept, and with Trade Up, 10 items of one rarity become one random item of the next.        Features   A desktop companion that sits on your taskbar and never steals focus: clicks pass straight through to your desktop.   Every key press and click counts. Only the number is kept, never which key.   A treat every 250 presses, plus care, a catch mini-game and day and night.   A box or a key every 30 minutes of play, opened on a reel with the odds shown.   7 device series with 20 looks each, 32 pet looks, 18 straps and 60 charms.   Five rarities, from Common to Mythic.   Tradable, marketable Steam Inventory items and a Trade Up contract.   A free Bongo Pass: 28-day seasons with 20 tiers of Bongo Points and treats.   Up to three devices on your desktop at once.   Light on your PC: it idles at a few frames per second.   Steam Achievements, 29 languages.   Free to Play. Keys and Random Boxes can also be bought in the in-game store.

name: Text To Speech
lang: English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Arabic*, Bulgarian*, Czech*, Danish*, Dutch*, Finnish*, Greek*, Hungarian*, Indonesian*, Japanese*, Norwegian*, Polish*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Portuguese - Portugal*, Romanian*, Russian*, Simplified Chinese*, Spanish - Latin America*, Swedish*, Turkish*, Ukrainian*, Vietnamese*, Hebrew*, Korean*, Thai*, Traditional Chinese*, Malay*
short: Text To Speech turns typed messages into speech with a huge choice of offline, neural and AI voices. Design unique voices, build a hotkey-ready soundboard, read chat aloud and shape live or generated voices. Made for games, streams and online communities. No subscription.
about: Cannot speak in multiplayer games or online chats? Type a message, press Enter and speak instantly through text-to-speech.  Whether your spouse is asleep, you have lost your voice to a winter cold, social anxiety has joined the lobby or you simply prefer typing over talking, Text To Speech is here to help. Built for games, streams and communities, it starts as a practical floating text box. Keep it simple or open more tools as you need them.  Queue messages, replay the last one or open your history to replay, copy and export useful lines as WAV files.  Become the keyboard warrior you were always meant to be.       Your everyday speech tools run locally on your computer. There is no monthly subscription and no separate app account.  Use instant built-in Windows voices or download local neural and AI voices when you want them:    Microsoft / Windows voices:  Instant built-in voices, including support for 32-bit SAPI 5 voices.   Piper:  A broad library of downloadable offline neural voices.   Kokoro:  Fast, modern neural voices with voice mixing. Also supports the Kokoro 1.1 checkpoint, providing another 100 Chinese voices!   Kitten:  Lightweight neural voices with impressive quality.   eSpeak NG:  Classic robotic voices with exceptional language coverage.   Qwen3:  Local AI speech with Voice Design and Reference Voice support.   Chatterbox:  Expressive local AI speech with Reference Voice support.   MOSS:  Local AI speech with Reference Voice support, a Nano variant and Voice Design.   Supertonic 3:  Lightning-fast, compact on-device TTS across 31 languages, with stable reading and low resource use.   VoxCPM2:  Expressive speech across 30 languages with natural language Voice Design plus controllable voice cloning and studio quality audio.   Pocket TTS:  Extremely lightweight local Reference Voice across English, German, Italian, Portuguese and Spanish.   MagpieTTS:  Multilingual speech with 5 preset voices.   VieNeu v3 Turbo:  English and Vietnamese speech with 23 preset voices.   SanoTTS:  Compact preset voices in multiple languages.   Keep favorites close, switch voices quickly and adjust pitch, speed, volume, mood, energy, effects and intensity until the result feels right.       Describe the voice you want by age, tone, pace, emotion and purpose. Voice Design creates a new voice around your description, making it fast and practical to try ideas and refine a character locally.  Create distinct voices for game characters and dialogue, build a cast for a larger project, narrate videos or produce game voice-over without searching through a fixed voice library. Voice Design supports Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish and Italian.  Reference Voice lets a recording you have permission to use guide the character and delivery of generated speech. Reuse a voice across scenes, give recurring characters a consistent identity or continue from a voice you have already developed. After the optional components are installed, generation stays on your computer.       Turn lyrics into a song with Text To Sing. Write the words, describe the sound you want and let local AI shape the melody and vocal performance—from a quick jingle to a character song.  Start with Auto melody, guide the performance with a hum or instrumental track, or transform an existing sung guide. With the optional Singing Voice Add-on, apply a selected TTS voice or permitted voice reference to the result. After the optional components are installed, generation stays on your computer.  Need a starting point? AI Assistance in the singing editor can refine your style prompt or turn a rough idea into structured, singable lyrics. Make a stream intro, a game character theme or a song for your cat’s big solo.       AI Assistance can rewrite a message before it speaks or before you copy it. Use ready-made instructions to fix grammar, make the wording professional or casual, shorten a long message, simplify it, translate it or adju

short: Selfie Worm is a cozy adventure blending squishy 2D physics with photography. Control an elastic worm through a colorless world, capturing selfies to restore vibrancy and uncover a heartwarming narrative. about: Selfie Worm    is a visually rewarding  2D physics platformer . Take control of a bouncy, elastic worm and leap through a monochrome alien world. Feel the pure joy of every collision and rebound in a stress-free environment designed for ultimate flow—no pressure, no failure, just pure relaxation.                  In this world of stark black and white outlines, your camera is the only key to bringing back the warmth. By capturing photos from the worm’s unique perspective, you’ll not only repaint the environment but also unlock hidden narrative fragments. These snippets reveal touching, heartwarming moments waiting to be discovered.                 Designed with a unique vertical window mode, the game mimics a mobile selfie experience while tucking neatly beside your work windows. It’s the perfect "healing" companion for your breaks. Features include:     【Anti-Boss Mode】 : Professional Camouflage Mode. Double-tap ESC to instantly switch to a realistic calculator interface for those "unexpected" situations.     【Productivity Tools】 : Built-in Focus Timer and Music Player. Let the worm keep you company during every focused work session.     【Zero-Stress Micro-Breaks】:  Levels are designed in 1-minute bursts—pick it up and put it down anytime to match your workflow.                         Collect various worm skins and camera filters to create your own unique social-ready photos.            Don't let your computer be worm-less!  Add  Selfie Worm  to your Wishlist now  for the latest dev updates and Demo news! about: Your Fiancée – AI Companion Expansion DLC  Bring new possibilities to your desktop companion with the  AI Companion Expansion Pack .  This DLC unlocks an AI integration interface for  Your Fiancée , allowing you to connect  most major large language models and compatible AI voice services  available on the market using your own API credentials.  In most cases, setup is simple: just enter your  API key  in the AI Companion settings, select the compatible service you want to use, and start interacting.  Once configured, your desktop companion can communicate with external AI models, generate dynamic conversations, use compatible AI voice services, and interact with supported in-game features.  Connect Your Own AI Service  The AI Companion Expansion Pack is designed to work with a wide range of mainstream AI providers.  It supports integration with  most major large language model services , as well as  compatible AI speech and voice-generation services .  Simply enter your own API key in the settings to connect a supported provider.  You are free to choose the AI service that best suits your needs, including different language models, model versions, and compatible voice services.  Any API usage fees, quotas, regional availability, service limitations, generated content, and provider policies are determined by the third-party service you choose.   This DLC does not include an AI model, API key, API credits, or built-in generative AI service.   It only provides the interface and features required to connect  Your Fiancée  with compatible external AI services.  GalGame Mode  Turn ordinary conversations into an interactive visual-novel-style experience.  When  GalGame Mode  is enabled, the AI can automatically generate  three dialogue choices  after each response.  Choose one of the options to continue the conversation and explore a different direction each time.  Every choice can lead to another set of choices, allowing conversations to branch continuously and creating an effectively unlimited interactive dialogue experience.  There is no fixed script and no predetermined route — the direction of the conversation depends on your choices and the AI service you connect.  AI Voice Integration  Compatible AI voice services can also be connected through the expansion.  This allows supported dialogue responses to be paired with AI-generated speech, giving your desktop companion a more expressive and immersive way to communicate.  Different providers may offer different voices, languages, speaking styles, and usage conditions.  AI-Powered Game Integration  The AI Companion Expansion Pack is not limited to simple chat.  Supported features inside  Your Fiancée  can also interact with the AI system, allowing your desktop companion to respond to information and actions from within the game.  This creates a deeper connection between the companion, the desktop tools, voice interaction, and your conversations, making the AI feel more integrated into the overall  Your Fiancée  experience. about: It's 2146. Yiling, a girl from New Shanghai, has just moved into her dorm at the Jiutian Institute of Interstellar Navigation. You'll be her companion through the days she spends studying and the hours she spends resting.    Bring whatever you'd like to do today. Or simply sit with her a while.    Getting to know her, one ordinary day at a time   Familiarity begins with a few unremarkable conversations.     The demo includes Chapters 1–3. Listen to Yiling talk about small moments on campus, and begin to know her and the world of 2146 from one dorm room.  The demo offers two environment moods, Clear and Dusk, along with 30 music tracks and around 10 ambient sounds.  Choosing outfits for Yiling, swapping out room props, and the particle effects generated from random formulas will all be added after the demo's release.    Leave a place for your own plans   You have things you want to do. She has today's coursework.     The demo's productivity tools are fully available. Use the Pomodoro timer to shape your focus, manage goals, to-dos and habits in the plan panel, and jot down ideas as they pass through. Plans can be advanced with the Pomodoro timer or marked complete by hand, and the calendar's history and data export are open as well.    This time together can continue   What you record today doesn't have to be written again.   Demo data and saves carry over to the full game in full. The growth progress, plan records and ideas you gather all come with you.  The demo will keep being updated after release, and the content above will be filled in over time.  If you enjoy these hours spent with Yiling, please consider adding the full game to your wishlist. There are more stories to share in the days ahead.

lang: Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
short: "Keyboard Farm" is a desktop idle farming game. Place it on your desktop and focus on your work. Every key is a plot of land—each keystroke helps plants grow. Harvest crops to collect coins, unlock various keycaps, and create your own keyboard world.
about: Thanks for playing our Demo! Enjoying your little farm? Add Keyboard Farm to your wishlist and stay tuned for news about the full release.   About the Keyboard Farm   Buddy, you can farm just by tapping your keyboard!  From today on, be a happy coder: type, grow crops, and harvest to your heart's content.  That's right, your keyboard is a little farm! Keep it on your desktop and watch greenery quietly grow across your keyboard while you focus on work.  The new Demo brings more tiles, an all-new buff system, and special buildings. Come see what's new on your farm!         Tap the Keyboard to Grow Crops   Plow, sow, and water. No keystroke goes to waste! Place your farm on your desktop and get on with your usual work. Every keystroke helps your plants grow, and harvesting mature crops earns you coins.         More Tiles, More Plants   A brand-new desert tile joins the farm! Pond and woodland tiles have also become more fertile, allowing you to grow a wider variety of plants. Unlock different tiles and collect all kinds of crops to make your keyboard farm flourish!         Make Your Keycaps Work Together!   Buy special keycaps from the shop to give nearby crops a boost!  Plan your layout to get the most out of every tile, or arrange everything your way and enjoy a relaxing farming break.         Learn Something While You Farm?   Build a school on your farm to unlock an exciting mini-game: vocabulary practice!  Wait, wasn't I supposed to be slacking off in Keyboard Farm? Why am I studying in a game, too?!         Mini Mode: A Tiny Farm on Your Desktop   Switch to the all-new Mini Mode with a single click! Your farm shrinks down to a more compact size, keeping you company on your desktop.         Customize Your Keyboard Farm   Spend your hard-earned coins on a variety of keycaps, unlock different tile and plant styles, and arrange your farm just the way you like. Give every keycap its place and turn your ordinary keyboard into a one-of-a-kind little world!         Track Your Typing Habits   Ever wonder how many times you press your keyboard each day?  Keyboard Farm tracks how often each key is pressed and generates a personal keyboard usage report.         A New Demo, with Plenty of Improvements   We've made a whole host of improvements, from visuals and controls to UI layout and stability. There are more improvements than carrots fresh out of the ground!  Welcome back to our Playtest veterans, and welcome to everyone joining us for the first time! Whether you love planning your farm, collecting plants, or simply adding a little greenery to your busy desktop, there's a little corner of the world here just for you.         Your Privacy Matters   We take your privacy seriously. Here's our promise:  The game only tracks keystroke frequency, meaning how often each key is pressed. It never records the actual text you type.  The game can run entirely offline.  All statistics are stored locally on your device and are never uploaded to external servers.  Type with peace of mind and enjoy your farming life!

name: Aifu
lang: English, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese
short: A 3D companion with a dynamic personality that adapts and responds uniquely to every interaction.
about: Aifu  is a 3D virtual companion designed to keep you company throughout your digital day. Unlike conventional, flat chatbots, Aifu is built to interact in a much more lifelike way: it can remember your conversations, grow alongside you through persistent memory, and recognize its own visual identity on screen.     Talk Naturally   Type a message or use voice dictation. Hear replies through native Windows speech synthesis or advanced voices, and choose the voice experience that suits you.     Identities and Persistent Memory   Create independent identities with their own personalities and conversation memories. Return to earlier topics across sessions, without sharing one identity’s memories with another. Each identity also knows what its avatar looks like and can talk about its own look and style.     Little Interactions   Give your companion a head pat and watch them react. Small gestures and animated expressions make everyday moments on your desktop a little more playful.             Make Yourself at Home   Click and drag your companion to a new spot on your desktop. Keep them close while you browse, study, or take a break.             Take a Play Break   Challenge Aifu to tic-tac-toe or chess, roll the dice, or leave a decision to a coin toss. Your companion reacts as you play, turning a short break into a shared moment.             Your Companion, Your Look   Import your own avatar, including VRM and unitypackage files, and make it feel at home on your screen. Depending on the model, you can customize different parts of its look. With any avatar, you can also adjust settings like the camera and lighting.             Free Daily Use   Enjoy  up to 30 free messages every day  to chat, connect, and spend time with Aifu.     A Little Help When You Need It   Share an image or screenshot for Aifu to discuss. Ask for an internet search, set a timer, or start a Pomodoro session in natural language. Optional desktop tools and integrations are used only when you enable them.     Agentic Capabilities and Vision   Aifu doesn’t just talk—it executes tasks to support your workflow:     Active Assistance:  Request real-time internet searches to resolve queries or manage timers and  Pomodoro  sessions using natural language.     Vision Capabilities:  Aifu can analyze what you see. Provide screenshots or paste images directly into the chat for your companion to process, analyze, and comment on.       By Fans, for Fans   We’re AifuStudio, a small independent team who love anime and technology. Aifu began as a companion we wanted on our own desktops. During Early Access, we’re improving the experience with feedback from the community.     Our Cost Philosophy   We want to be 100% transparent: our main goal is not to make a profit. In order for Aifu’s responses to be smart, fluid, and backed by real memory, we rely on infrastructure providers and external high-performance AI servers that charge us for every single interaction.  The application’s pricing model is strictly designed to make the project sustainable and viable over time, covering these direct technical costs. Every single coin collected is reinvested into keeping the servers running and funding the development of new features. Thank you for helping us bring this dream to life!      Avatar Credits:    The avatar shown is Mori, created by Torinyan, with concept design by Limebreaker. Mori is a third-party avatar used to demonstrate Aifu.

name: CielChan: Anime Desktop AI Companion
lang: English*, French*, Italian*, Spanish - Spain*, Japanese*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Simplified Chinese*, Hindi*, Dutch*, Russian*, Turkish*, German*, Ukrainian**
short: A presence on your desktop, even when you're not talking. When enabled, she can see what's on your screen, hear your computer's audio, and react in her own time while you work, watch, or play. Runs offline. No subscription.
about: A companion for the everyday moments.  CielChan is an animated AI companion who stays on your desktop while you work, study, browse, play, or unwind. Talk with her by voice or text, or simply let her keep you company in the corner of your screen.  When you enable observation, she can occasionally comment using available context from your active window, screenshots, and configured system audio. These are periodic observations, not continuous human-like sight or hearing, and they can be inaccurate.  Her local memory can retrieve selected details from earlier conversations, so she can feel more familiar over time. She will not remember everything, and her responses may vary with the model you use.          Share a little of your day    Watch Together can bring her reactions to supported videos, games, browsing, and other desktop activities, using available visual and audio context.    Ask her to read supported text files and EPUB books aloud, or enjoy conversations, companion minigames, and shared online rooms.    Use Focus Companion for timed sessions, breaks, check-ins, notes, tasks, reminders, and ambient sounds such as rain or café ambience.    Move or resize her transparent overlay, use click-through when needed, and reposition the toolbar to suit your workspace.    Optional webcam Presence recognises supported gestures; compatible avatars can also sit on the edges of suitable application windows.    Memory and everyday assistance    Recall can save selected screen and audio moments locally and help you search for something you saw or heard earlier. You control when it is enabled and how captures are retained.    Desktop Tools can search the web, read supported documents, create files, and help with other permitted actions. File access is limited to authorised locations.    Goals can plan and attempt multi-step tasks using the tools available to them. Goals and tool execution are experimental; success depends on the model, permissions, and task.    With Observation Tools enabled, eligible observations can also trigger configured tool instructions. This is optional.    Make her your own    Adjust her personality, behaviour, voice, and appearance. Personalise Ciel can propose supported changes from plain-language instructions for you to review.    Use supported VRM, Live2D, or sprite avatars, create characters, and share supported character-and-personality pairs through Steam Workshop.    Choose from the included local AI and voice options, or configure compatible GGUF models and supported voices. Compatibility and performance depend on your hardware and installed assets.    Connect only when you want to  Optional connections include Twitch, YouTube Live, TikTok Live, Discord, Telegram, Multiplayer, and the Codex desktop app. Advanced users can also configure OpenAI, Anthropic, or OpenRouter for cloud AI, and supported cloud voice services such as ElevenLabs. Availability varies by service and setup.  Local first, with clear choices  CielChan's core chat, local memory, and bundled local voice and AI features can run offline after installation. No cloud account, API key, or subscription is needed for the offline core experience.  Local conversations and local processing stay on your PC. Enabled online integrations may send relevant text, audio, images, or account and presence information to the services you choose; separate accounts, fees, or API keys may apply. Third-party availability can change.  Good to know  CielChan is an AI companion, not a human-level autonomous assistant. Conversations, memories, observations, and tool results can be mistaken, repetitive, delayed, or inconsistent. Vision, Tools, Goals, and some integrations are experimental.  Speech recognition, voice options, and AI response quality vary by language, model, and installed voice components. Performance while gaming or multitasking depends on your hardware and the features you enable.  One-time purchase  Pay once to use the included offline core feature

How it works  Increase the Warrior strength to advance through stages full of monsters and reach the final map.              Did you fail? Worry not, the Warrior never actually dies; he grows stronger with each enemy defeated. Gain experience, level up, and spend points on your abilities, and then, try again! Unlock the Warrior full potential by mastering each one of them and unleash the chaos. name: Keepwatch: Idle Kingdom RPG
lang: English, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish
short: A hero who lives above your taskbar. Keepwatch is an idle auto-battler RPG that quietly runs on your desktop — build your camp, gear up your one and only hero, and let them fight while you get back to work.
about: A world that lives on your desktop     Keepwatch: Idle Kingdom RPG is a medieval auto-battler that lives right above your Windows taskbar. You command a single hero — but not directly. They wander, work, grow, and fight incoming enemies on their own. Your role is to grow your camp, make gear and skill decisions, and step in at critical moments.    The game stays open on your desktop until you close it. It runs quietly in the background at its own pace, never interrupting your real work — but there's always something happening if you glance over.                 One hero, one path!            There's no class selection — a single archetype. What makes your build interesting doesn't come from a character creation screen, it comes from  your skill tree and the gear you find . Your hero grows stronger by leveling up, but the real difference comes from your armor, your weapon, and the skill choices you make. By day, your hero works around camp, gathers resources, and builds. When night falls, the real threat begins: waves of enemies march on your camp, and your hero fights them automatically.                   Build your camp, grow your kingdom!      Five different buildings, each upgradeable up to ten tiers:  Home, Blacksmith, Kitchen, Workshop, Vault.  Each gives your hero a different edge — passive experience, crafting recipes, storage capacity, or gear upgrades. The more you develop your buildings, the stronger the gear your hero can access.       Home    Blacksmith    Kitchen              Your hero passively earns experience here while idle around camp.            The heart of weapon and armor upgrades — higher tiers raise your success chance.            Recipes crafted here feed your hero's endurance and recovery.      Workshop    Vault                  The crafting hub for clothing, bags, and potions.            Keep your inventory and gold safely stored.             Automatic combat, real tension!      The moment your hero spots an enemy, they fight — closing the distance, attacking, and using skills automatically. Your job is preparing the right gear and skill tree; your hero handles the rest.            Three tiers, one glance to read  Every enemy silhouette tells you everything you need to know before the fight starts:     Raider  — light, narrow, unarmored. Fast and weak on their own, dangerous in a crowd.     Soldier  — mid-sized, partial armor, often carries a shield. The baseline threat once your camp is established.     Champion  — broad-shouldered, fully armored, slow but hits hard and soaks up damage.    No health bars to squint at — silhouette alone tells you what you're facing at a glance.  Ten cultures, one battlefield    Every enemy tier comes reskinned across ten distinct cultures — Arabian, British, Chinese, Frank, Holy Roman, Iberian, Japanese, Roman, Turkish, and Viking — drawn at random per spawn. A night wave can throw a Viking raider and a Japanese raider at you side by side. Culture is purely cosmetic: it never changes stats, weapons, or behavior, so the only thing you ever need to read off an enemy is its silhouette.       Arabian    British    Chinese    Frank    Holy Roman                                                          Iberian    Japanese    Roman    Turkish    Viking                                                           Weapons and range are never fixed    Enemies don't carry a hardcoded loadout. On spawn, each one draws from its tier's weapon pool — the same weapon catalog your hero uses — which also decides whether it's carrying a shield and what level its weapon sits at. Anyone wielding a bow or crossbow fights at range instead of melee; there's no separate "archer" type, ranged is simply a consequence of the weapon drawn. The same soldier who closed to melee last night might hang back with a bow the next.      Every upgrade is a real risk!      Gear doesn't just get better with gold — it gets  rarer . Pushing a weapon or piece of armor toward its cap means gambling gol

Physics: place her on your windows or drop her to your taskbar    Click on her to make her happy: she gets sad if you don’t pay attention    She gazes at your mouse    And dancing!                 More About Your New Companion   She's not just sitting there waiting, Her fully physics-driven body means every interaction feels dynamic and unpredictable. lang: English, Korean
short: Your monitor is the aquarium. Type and click as you always do: your input becomes food, fish grow on your desktop, and gold piles up while you work. about: Your desktop is the aquarium   fih is a desktop companion game where fish grow beside you while you work. They swim on a transparent window over your whole screen, but every click that does not land on a fish, a pellet, a shark or the UI passes straight through to the window behind. It never gets in your way.   Your typing is the food  Every keypress and click counts as one input. Every 30 inputs, a pellet drops with a little pop. Hungry fish swim over, eat, gain weight, and grow from egg to baby, child, teen and adult. Grown fish earn gold every ten seconds — five minutes of a fish's passive income adds up to its own sell price, so the tank keeps working while you are away. No fish ever starves to death.   Roll, collect, raise  Three kinds of eggs hatch 29 species: 10 ornamental fish, 10 mid-size edible fish, 5 legendary rarities such as the coelacanth, and 4 unique memes (CatFih, ShoesFih, Dih, SelFih). On top of the species roll, every individual rolls its own rarity. The base art is a black crayon sketch on white paper, and rarer individuals get colored over it — pale blue for rare, gold for legendary, a shifting rainbow for unique. Hatch a species once and it unlocks in the collection.   Draw your own fish  An in-game paint panel lets you draw a fish's look yourself. Keep several looks per species in its gallery, and newly hatched fish will wear one of them at random.   Sharks show up  Every 8 to 15 minutes a warning blinks at the edge of the screen and a police siren wails. Your adults swim in to fight; click the shark to add damage. Kill it for a growing reward, or lose fish if you are slow. This is the only place in the game where you can lose anything.   Eight upgrades  Passive income, sell income, feeding rate, food value, auto-clicks per second, rare chance, tank capacity, and combat power.   Pick your monitors  Choose which displays the fish may roam, and they will swim from one monitor to the next. Korean and English are supported, and the aquarium hides itself when a fullscreen app takes over.   Privacy  The global input hook counts events and nothing else. Which keys you pressed is never stored, logged, or sent anywhere.

short: A living 3D desktop companion for your workspace. Pin a cozy Lo-Fi room over your code, browser, or anywhere on your desktop. Customize your room and avatar, enjoy relaxing music, and let your little companion read, work, and sleep while you do your thing.
about: Lofi Cozy Room puts a tiny living room on your desktop and runs gentle Lo-Fi underneath it while you work.  An avatar and a dog moving around inside a transparent window, furniture that reacts when you click it, and 180 Lo-Fi tracks to make the hours you spend working a little kinder. 0. Mini Mode and Work Tools, Right on Your Desktop Not a screensaver. Not a wallpaper. A living mini-room sits quietly in the corner of your desktop, inside a transparent window with no frame around it.   If the full window takes up too much room, switch to Mini Mode. Drag it wherever you need it: over your code, over your browser, anywhere on screen.   Notes, a to-do list, a diary, a Pomodoro timer and a music panel are all built in. Every tool window moves with the mouse, and you can keep several open at once. Dual monitors are supported, so windows and panels travel freely from one screen to the other. 1. A Cozy Mini-Room of Your Own Decorate the mini-room you've been picturing. Rooms, furniture and little props for every mood you can think of.  A room you've arranged yourself makes the hours pass calmer and warmer.  Press Arrange in the decor panel to move, rotate, raise, and resize furniture. Use snapping, undo, or reset, and your layout saves automatically. Your avatar adapts to the new arrangement.                 2. Gentle Lo-Fi and Soft Ambient Sound Fill your mini-room with Lo-Fi tracks and quiet ambient sound. Somewhere along the way your head goes quiet, and you look up already deep in your work.  And it's not just the built-in tracks — register music files from your own computer as local music and play them right alongside.  Every track in the game is royalty-free. Play them on stream or in a YouTube video without a single copyright worry.         3. A Mini-Room With Something Going On The mini-room isn't just there to be looked at. Click the furniture around the room — each piece has its own small reaction.  Your avatar isn't stuck in a single animation loop either. Reading on the sofa, working at the desk, resting in the armchair, and off to bed once night falls.  Your avatar now walks naturally between activities instead of teleporting. Turn on Autonomy in the ACTIVITY panel to let them choose activities, visit other rooms, and sometimes wave, laugh, or dance. Your own choices always come first. 4. Your Avatar and Your Dog Build the character you want to look at all day. Face, hair and outfit are all yours to set, and you can save as many avatars as you like. Or just pick one of the ready-made characters and pets and let them keep you company.  A little dog wanders the room on its own and curls up for a nap wherever the sun lands.         5. At a Glance - Keep a transparent mini-room floating in the corner of your desktop. - Move between 14 mini-rooms with a single click. - Show or hide furniture piece by piece to build the mood you want. - Click around the room to turn up hidden reactions. - Follow your avatar through a whole day of reading, working and sleeping. - Share the room with a dog that goes wherever it pleases. - Customize face, hair and outfit to build an avatar of your own. - Or pick a favourite from the ready-made characters and pets. - Listen to 180 hand-picked Lo-Fi tracks. - Layer ambient sounds until the atmosphere is exactly right. - Shuffle, repeat and mute straight from the mini music player. - Amber builds up just from leaving the room open, unlocking new rooms and items one at a time. - Keep the day in order with notes, a to-do list and a Pomodoro timer. - Tuck the whole thing into a corner of the screen with Mini Mode. - Switch UI themes so it sits well with the rest of your desktop. - No timers pushing you. No in-app purchases.
