about: She holds the road. You make her stronger.  A girl in a red hood, a silver bow shaped like a crescent moon, and a road that monsters pour down until the end of time. She fights on her own. What she turns into is up to you.      Moonbow Idle is a dark fantasy idle auto battler. Leave it running on a second monitor while you get on with your day, or sit down and chase the next boss. It works either way.     What you actually do    Spend gold on seven upgrades, from Damage to Counter Attack, and watch the next wave fall faster than the last.    Pick one of three perks every time you level up: pierce more enemies, hit harder, shrug off more damage.    Unlock the Arsenal: venom, fire, frost, orbiting souls, chain lightning, arrow volleys, explosions and hail. It's the expensive stuff, and it makes fights look completely different.       A long way down the road  210 stages across seven biomes: meadow, swamp, volcano, ice, ruins, desert and the shadow lands. Each one looks and feels different.      And the monsters are more than reskins. Some poison you, some heal their friends, some come in swarms, and some get back up after you've killed them.      There's a boss every ten stages, and at the very end the Eclipse Sovereign is waiting.     Pets, loot, and a good reason to ascend    Bosses drop eggs. Hatch them to collect up to 21 companions, take three along, and give each one a skill you can fire yourself or leave on auto.          36 pieces of gear in six sets. Wear two or four from the same set and you get something fun: permanent poison, a freezing wind, a second life.          Got a duplicate? Great, it levels up.    When a run gets too hard, ascend. You trade it for relics that boost everything for good, keep your pets and gear, and go again. Farther every time.       Good to know    Idle progress, plus a reward waiting for you when you come back.    Game speed up to x3 (one of the gear sets unlocks x3).    Full controller support, Pets and Gear tabs included.    20 achievements. English, Ukrainian and Simplified Chinese.    Pixel art and music by xDeviruchi.

Whether you stream gaming, speedruns, creative art, or Just Chatting, StreamSpark transforms passive lurkers into an active, laughing community.          ✨ 1. DEEP LOREBOOKS & CHANNEL ENCYCLOPEDIAS     Turn your companion into the ultimate channel insider who knows all your community's culture:       Instant World Lore Injections : Build custom encyclopedias for your favorite games, fictional universes, channel rules, or running memes.     Speaks Your Community's Language : When chat mentions a channel meme, a rival streamer, or specific game lore, your companion instantly pulls from its lorebook to deliver contextual, razor-sharp commentary.     Teach It Live in Chat : Streamers can teach their companion new facts about viewers or channel lore on the fly, permanently updating its knowledge base without leaving the game.     Shareable Lorebooks : Export and import community lorebooks to quickly share game guides or fictional world bibles with other creators.            👁️ 4. EYES ON YOUR SCREEN: IT ACTUALLY SEES YOUR GAME     Most stream bots are completely blind to what you are doing. about: Crawling Desktop Pet  is a companion-focused creature-raising game that brings an unusual little lifeform onto your Windows desktop.  It follows your cursor, crawls freely across the screen, and reacts to toys and its surroundings. Or it can simply stay by your side while you work, study, browse, or relax.     From Egg to Desktop Companion   Tap the shell and hatch your first desktop companion.  Feed it, care for it, and watch it grow and evolve as new interactions and collectibles gradually become available. Your pet also produces Crystals that can be used to obtain food, upgrades, scenes, toys, and new companions.          Raise and Collect   Hatch different pet eggs, raise multiple companions, and switch the pet that stays with you whenever you like.  More possibilities open up as you progress. Arrange different scenes, place a variety of toys, and see how your pets react. You can also unlock achievements and personalization items to give your presence a more distinctive look.           Create a Creature of Your Own   Each pet is driven in real time by a procedural skeletal system rather than fixed, pre-rendered animations.  Adjust the proportions, structure, movement, and appearance of individual body parts to create something gentle, strange, elegant, or completely unexpected. Designs can be saved, imported, and exported, making it easy to keep experimenting or share your creations.           A Companion on Your Terms   Switch between the full window and transparent desktop modes. Hide interface elements, reduce notifications, or enable mouse click-through whenever you need a quieter desktop.  Whether you want to focus on raising and creating or simply keep a small creature resting in the corner of your screen,  Crawling Desktop Pet  can fit naturally into your routine.   Connect with Friends   Invite friends for online interactions, show off your pets and personalized looks, and discover more lighthearted ways to spend time together. short: The immortal path begins in Qi Refinement. In this desktop idle RPG, up to three cultivators battle on their own. Choose their techniques, forge equipment, and open the chests won along the way. Gather cultivation and prepare for the next breakthrough.
about: The Long Road Begins in Qi Refinement  Every cultivator must take a first step. Set out with Gale Lu of the Falling Cloud Sword Sect, send flying swords against beasts, and open the treasure chests won along the way. Hone your techniques and ready your artifacts for the realms ahead.  Mortal Cultivators: Idle Companions is an idle cultivation RPG that unfolds in a small window on your desktop. Your squad battles on its own. Which techniques to study, which equipment to forge, and which companions to send into battle are yours to decide. Companions on the Cultivation Path  Gale Lu commands flying swords. Violet uses talismans to hold enemies in check. Jade Lin fights at close range with alchemical implements, sustaining her companions with healing and buffs. Unlock cultivators and squad slots as you progress, choosing up to three companions to travel together.  Spend each cultivator's skill points on attributes and active skills, choose two active skills and their order, and arrange your squad to meet the enemy. When the path grows difficult, rework your techniques or return to cleared encounters to gather cultivation and equipment before trying again. Treasures to Find, Artifacts to Forge  Equipment and materials await within the chests gathered on your journeys. Find weapons, armor, and accessories that suit your companions. With greater strength, challenge stage bosses in search of rarer chests.  Craft equipment from materials, synthesize items of the same category, or socket materials into your equipment. Transmute unwanted items into gold through alchemy to fund the cultivation still to come. Gather Cultivation, Cross into New Realms  Each cultivator gathers cultivation independently. Reach the current stage's limit and gather the required gold, then choose when to break through into the next realm. Unlock Constellation nodes to strengthen your squad, improve rewards, and expand your inventory and storage.  Progress also awaits your return. After you close the game, cultivation and gold accrue based on your selected idle encounter, ready to collect when you come back. The Trading House · Steam Community Market  The fruits of your journeys can find their way to other cultivators. The full game will support Steam Inventory and Community Market trading at launch. Transfer eligible base equipment and materials through the in-game Trading House to your Steam Inventory, then sell them on the Community Market. Items purchased on the Market can be received and used in the game.

about: Meet Xiaoya and experience a new way to interact with a lifelike AI companion!  Imagine talking face-to-face with a realistic digital human who listens and responds naturally. Speak whenever you want, interrupt whenever you need, and enjoy a conversation that feels much closer to talking with a real person.  That's the experience CyberMate aims to bring to you.  NATURAL, REAL-TIME VOICE CONVERSATIONS  Say goodbye to rigid, turn-based voice chats where you have to wait for the AI to finish speaking before you can respond. Talk with Xiaoya naturally and interrupt her at any time to jump in, change the subject, or continue your thoughts. Enjoy a more fluid, spontaneous conversational experience.  A LIFELIKE 3D AVATAR WITH REAL-TIME LIP SYNC  Xiaoya features a realistic 3D digital human appearance, with lip movements synchronized to her speech in real time. Watch her speak and respond as you interact, making every conversation feel more immersive and engaging.  FULLY LOCAL. TRULY OFFLINE.  Speech recognition, text-to-speech, and AI conversation models all run locally on your computer. No internet connection is required for use, no cloud API calls are needed, and there are no additional per-message or per-minute fees.  No API bills. No usage-based charges. No subscription required for ongoing conversations. Once your local setup is ready, you can enjoy unlimited conversations without paying for every interaction.  MAKE YOUR OWN DIGITAL HUMAN  You're not limited to Xiaoya's default appearance. Customize your digital companion's look and voice to suit your preferences. You can even use a photo of your choice to create a personalized digital human and enjoy natural, real-time voice conversations with your custom avatar. Experience real-time AI voice interaction on your own computer without relying on paid cloud AI services or recurring subscription fees. YOUR COMPANION, YOUR EXPERIENCE  From casual conversations with Xiaoya to exploring different digital appearances and voices, the experience is yours to personalize. Discover a more natural, flexible, and personal way to interact with AI.  No internet connection required. No API fees. No dependence on cloud services. name: Dockable
lang: English*, Spanish - Spain*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Simplified Chinese*, Ukrainian*, French*, Italian*, German*, Portuguese - Portugal*, Spanish - Latin America**
short: Bring the elegance of the macOS Dock to Windows 11. Dockable is a beautiful bottom dock with magnifying icons, a Liquid Glass bar, light/dark themes, and smooth genie-style minimize animations — mirroring your taskbar apps in a cleaner, more delightful way.
about: Dockable  — a macOS-style dock for Windows 11  If you like the macOS Dock but use Windows, Dockable brings that familiar feel to your desktop. It puts your pinned and running apps in a translucent bar, with icons that grow as you move across them and several ways to animate windows as they minimize.  Familiar dock behavior  Dockable starts with your taskbar’s pinned apps, then lets you arrange and manage your dock separately. Running apps appear alongside your pins.  Icons magnify smoothly under your cursor. Adjust their starting size and magnification to suit your screen, or turn the effect off if you prefer things to stay still.    Drag to reorder, drop files to pin them, and drag pins off the dock to remove them    Running indicators show which apps are open, with a bounce when an app launches    Choose whether windows minimize into their app icon    Choose your look  Choose a simple translucent background, live acrylic blur, or  Liquid Glass . Liquid Glass adds frosted blur, refraction around the edges, and a soft highlight that moves across the surface.  The settings let you adjust blur, distortion, tint, saturation, chromatic aberration, and the rim highlight. Keep it subtle or spend some time getting the look just right.  Three ways to minimize  Pick  Genie ,  Suck , or  Scale  to control how windows move into the dock, then adjust the animation speed. Click a minimized window’s tile to bring it back.  Light or dark  Let Dockable follow your Windows theme, or set it to light or dark yourself. Soft shadows give the icons a little depth in either mode.  An optional menu bar  Add a macOS-style menu bar to the top of your screen. It shows the focused app’s name and gives you access to its window menu, a keyboard-layout switcher, shortcuts to Quick Settings and Notifications, and a clock.  Keep the taskbar—or hide it  Leave the Windows taskbar visible, set it to auto-hide, or hide it completely while Dockable is running. Your original taskbar setting is restored when Dockable closes.  Available in eight languages  Dockable supports  English, Português (Brasil), Español, Українська, Français, Italiano, Deutsch, and 中文 (简体) . It matches your system language on first launch, and you can switch languages in settings without restarting.  Built for Windows 11  Dockable is a native, self-contained app with no extra dependencies to install. It supports per-monitor DPI scaling to keep things sharp across different displays, with a Preferences window for adjusting its appearance and behavior.

name: Magic Borderless
lang: English, Korean
short: This must-have, ultimate gamer app is more than an automatic borderless tool. Magic Borderless auto detects any games & applies your preferences. It also includes mouse locks, multi-monitor & widescreen goodies, volume manager, multitasking assistance, and privacy features like Ninja Mode *wink wink*.
about: Experience the responsive windowed gaming ON FULLSCREEN SIZE without the ugly borders! Magic Borderless is an application to help gamers play games on fullscreen windowed without the ugly borders. Windowed mode gaming lets gamers instantly switch to other windows in the same computer while they are dead (because they suck) or waiting on loading screens, without having to see Windows go ape nuts when alt-tabbing. Some games even crash when alt-tabbed, but Magic Borderless is here to prevent that as well!   The app tries to help you be as lazy as possible and do the work for you as much as possible... for free*!  *(Well, after you pay for the app.)  Extra helpful features are also added to assist gamers when it comes to managing windows on their monitors, such as Ninja Mode where it allows you to hide and mute a window for... um, science!   Automatic Game Detection When you run your game on windowed or fullscreen mode, Magic Borderless can detect it without you ever have to manually add them every time. If this feature is enabled, it will ask you if you wish to apply the borderless magic. When the magic is applied for the first time, all you have to do is set your game to run on windowed mode once. Magic Borderless will take care of the rest automatically every time the game launches. You can also set to apply default configurations to all detected games without ever asking you! Improved Borderless Algorithm There are different ways to make a window borderless, but all of them often has trouble resizing window properly or suffer from graphical errors. Magic Borderless has improved code to combat these issues for you and will work on even more games! It has the highest compatibility list of all borderless software available! Customizable Additional Magic Besides making your favorite games borderless, you can also set the game to run on a specific window size or simply maximize to your monitor's resolution. If you wish to keep your Taskbar up, you can also toggle it to make sure the window does not hide the Taskbar. Some also prefer their borderless windowed mode to behave like real fullscreen apps (minimize the window on alt-tab). For those weirdos, you can set the Alt+Tab behavior to minimize the window. Ninja Mode: Instant Hide and Mute By pressing [Alt] + [X], you can activate Ninja Mode on your currently active window. This will not only completely hide them from taskbar and among opened windows, it will also mute that particular window only! This feature is also available to Alt+Tab behaviors for any games you configured! Cursor Lock Some noob developers forgot to add cursor lock to their games on windowed mode (or they believed it is how they should behave). If you don't like this behavior, no worries! Magic Borderless can lock your cursor to that window OR the monitor (for our beloved multi-monitor users). Muti-monitor Assistance Magic Borderless can stretch a game window across all of your monitors so you can it big! The program also provides additional tools like mouse cursor centering and Window-Escape feature to assist you on multitasking! Volume Manager Instead of going through a number of clicks to adjust the volume of your apps, Magic Borderless can help you adjust them reliably through its own UI. You can also change the background volume so when they are not being used their audio volume can be either reduced or muted completely!

about: An idle squad shooter that sits along the bottom of your screen while you work.  Four pixel cat commandos, and later a fifth, hold the line on their own, tagging an endless herd of robots and critters for bounty. You glance down, click to help if you like, and get back to work.          Somewhere out there, an AI keeps generating worlds and enemies to conquer mankind. Your cats are on the task.    Your squad works while you work  The strip sits above your taskbar, beside whatever you're doing, and never takes your focus: you keep typing, they keep fighting. Check in between tasks, then get back to it.    Meet the squad          ROOK fires your clicks, then goes automatic. ECHO's laser pierces every critter in a line. TORCH wants them close. BRICK brings rockets for the walls and the bosses. Now and then one of them checks in on you: "GOT YOUR MORNING COFFEE YET?" And somewhere down the Line, a fifth cat, LOOP, is waiting to be rescued.    Click when you like          Every click is a shot from ROOK's rifle, and the herd pays out in bounty as it pops. You never have to: your squad can hold the line without you.    A new world every few kilometres          Fourteen stretches of the Line, from neon junctions and silent steelworks to a frozen ice plate and a salt flat, each with its own herd, its own robots and a gate boss at the end.    Bank it, refit the crew, drop back in          When the tally sack is full, bring in the dropship. File the claim at the ship, refit the crew room by room, and drop back in where you left off. The first minute back is a massacre (a cartoon one).    Made to stay out of your way    Never takes your focus and never reads your keyboard: it's mouse-only.    One click hides it to a small tab; arrows move it to another monitor.    It reads your screen's size, never your windows or other programs.    No admin rights, no account, and it connects to nothing except Steam.    One price. No microtransactions, no ads, no loot boxes. name: Spirit Gems
lang: English
short: A cozy desktop idle game with 100 spirits, 156 gemstone heirlooms and five magical gardens. Grow a tiny workshop along your taskbar, make friends, restore distant groves and explore Lantern Descent while you work, browse or play. All cosmetic collections are included.
about: Make a little room for magic  Spirit Gems brings an enchanted elven workshop to the bottom of your Windows desktop. Watch tiny artisans gather gems, craft treasures and trade their creations while you work, browse or play. Check in for a new heirloom, a curious visitor or a quiet journey into the woods.          Befriend 100 delightful spirits         From moss foxes and coral axolotls to the Frostpetal Alicorn, curious companions are waiting to meet you. Decorate habitats to attract visitors, follow journal clues and fulfil their heirloom wishes to deepen your friendships. Pin up to three trusted favourites beside your artisans. Visitors stay until you greet them, so you can return when it suits you.  Craft 156 heirlooms          Turn rough gems into rings, crowns, spellbooks and other tiny treasures across eleven collections. Choose a design to craft, work towards its mastery and put your favourites on display. Eight gemstone collections begin your journey; three regional collections add 36 designs to discover through the Field Journal.  Make five magical gardens your own          Befriend more spirits to unlock Emerald Grove, Moonwater Lagoon, Starbough Canopy, Frostpetal Conservatory and Glowcap Grotto. Arrange friends and decorations, adjust their size and find a home for every keepsake. Each garden remembers its own layout.  Follow the Field Journal beyond the grove  After reaching Starcrown Canopy, discover Amberfall Wetlands, Crystalwind Terrace and Lanternroot Hollow. Complete journal pages to reveal new heirloom designs, help restore each region and earn keepsakes and portal arches. Optional Quiet Grove journeys reward a little patience: leave Heart Tree Bloom resting until your party returns to earn the challenge bonus.  Lantern Descent sends your party on a peaceful, non-combat expedition below the roots. Choose a scenic route, pause or return when you like, and collect decorations at depth milestones. Your best depth stays recorded for the next visit.  One game, all the cosmetic collections  Personalise your grove with seven pets, 24 additional character looks, six portal styles, six display frames and 18 furnishing alternatives. Moonlit Opal brings pearlescent workshop styles, gentle atmospheres and accessories for trusted spirit friends. These collections are included with the base game, alongside decorations and character looks earned through play.  The downloadable 23-track MP3 soundtrack and four wallpapers are included in the installation, too.  A little progress, at your own pace  Upgrade your workshop, earn automation and send your elves on peaceful Forest Quests. Collect offline earnings, discover permanent blessings and renew your grove while keeping your treasured collections. Adjust the strip size, text size, lighting and motion to suit your desktop.  Settle into the taskbar strip or spend a little longer decorating a garden. Your next small discovery is waiting.

name: Sternenreich
lang: English, German
short: Build a star empire without a game hurrying you along. Everyone moves together, usually once an hour – for weeks. Settle planets, raise fleets, forge alliances. The same empire on PC, phone and browser. No in-game purchases.
about: Build a star empire without a game hurrying you along You begin with a single home world. From there it grows into an empire: settle planets, put up buildings, raise fleets, hold your ground – against other people doing the same. The tick Everyone moves together, once an hour in the long round. On each tick, production, building queues, flights and battles all move one step on. You do not have to be there: if you see a hostile fleet inbound, you have hours to think of something. On PC the game lets you know in the taskbar, on your phone with a notification.  This is deliberately not a game that pulls you back every ten minutes. One empire, three screens On PC, on your Android phone and in the browser you play the same empire in the same round. Send the fleet out at your desk in the morning, check on your phone whether it has arrived.  To be upfront: the Android app and the browser version are free, and you play in the same round there. Buying it here gets you the PC version with Steam sign-in and supports development – it does not buy you any advantage in the game. A universe that grows with its players 49 galaxies arranged in a ring. The richest planets and the most dangerous neighbours are at the centre; the outer rim is poor and quiet. At the start only the centre is open; with every player who joins, more galaxies open up. Late joiners find room – and the same hard start as everyone else. A round is always running   Every weekend a fast round with one move per minute   Every two weeks a round with ten minutes per move   Plus the long round at one move an hour, over three months  A round is a self-contained game with a beginning and an end. Then everyone starts from zero again – no three-year head start you can never catch up with. You cannot lose early Your home world cannot be conquered. Even if you lose every colony, you start over from home and play on until the round ends. There is no elimination. Alliances, corporations, radio Team up, share what you see, agree on targets, declare war on each other – or break the pact at the right moment. Corporations hold together across rounds, a public radio channel connects everyone. Every battle comes with a receipt: ship by ship, what was there, what was lost, what remained. Practise first Against computer opponents no clock runs against you: you trigger every move yourself, one at a time or ten in a row. The practice game needs no account and no internet. What is not in it This version has no ads and no in-game purchases. No energy bars, no waiting you can pay to skip, no paying for an advantage. No tracking.

name: STICKMAN DESKTOP MALWARS
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, Hebrew
short: A physics stickman brawler on a living computer desktop. The taskbar is the floor, windows are platforms and every app opens a new arena. Brawl as eight ragdoll fighters, each with their own attacks, or be the giant mouse cursor: charge a RAM, run VirusGuard on them and open a black hole.
about: Wishlist now: a stickman brawl inside your computer Something got into your computer, and it brought friends.  STICKMAN DESKTOP MALWARS is a physics brawler for up to five players on one PC, fought on a living desktop. Loose ragdoll stickmen punch, kick, throw and swing across it: the taskbar is the floor, title bars are platforms, and every app or web page you open goes full screen and becomes a new arena.  One player can take the mouse and become the giant cursor. Grab stickmen by the head and fling them, charge a RAM through the crowd, run VirusGuard on them, draw ink weapons that really work or open a black hole in the middle of the fight. Everyone else fights back as the stickmen, and bots fill every empty seat.         Two ways to play    Stickmen:  up to four fighters, any mix of friends and bots; the last one standing wins the round    Mouse vs stickmen:  one player is the cursor against up to four stickmen   Bots at four levels, from EASY to INSANE, for solo play   Eight fighters, each with their own attacks Every fighter has four special attacks, a move of their own and a super move. Every blow is physics: the hits land on loose ragdoll bodies and send them flying.    Heavy:  a hurricane punch, a grab and slam, a floor hammer that shakes the whole desktop, and a meteor super    Grappler:  web attacks: a reel punch, a web whip, a sky slam and a web snare, then swing away on the hook    Riposte:  a roundhouse that parries and kicks back, flying kicks, flip kicks that juggle, an axe kick and a counter stance    Elastic:  rubber arms: a jab that reels you in, a slingshot haymaker, an uppercut and a floor quake; he slings himself off almost anything    Kinetic:  telekinesis: lift fighters and desktop junk and throw them; a heat-haze flight    Hacker:  two guns, a wall of pop-ups, and windows he crashes, takes over, rams into you or slams shut on you    OVERCLOCK:  an exploding fist, a sun ball, a magma slam and a fiery dive; his fire burns holes in windows and pages    GLITCH:  frame skips, blinks, desyncs, phases and clones of himself          Be the mouse   Hold to charge the RAM, crash through the stickmen and chain the hits into a CRASH!   Run VirusGuard on them: a quarantine jar, a firewall of burning bricks, missiles, a magnet. The stickmen can punch its buttons too   Draw it and it works: a circle becomes a ball, a box and a circle a cannon, a line on two wheels a car. Strokes join while the ink is still wet   The Sketchbook shows every drawing and how to draw it; pick one and your next scribble becomes it   Drop anvils and windows, grab with an iron grip, open a black hole          A desktop to wreck   Hard hits crack the wallpaper; break through it and see what is behind   Hit a fighter hard enough and he cuts a small window in two along his flight   Close, throw and snap windows, stop or rewind the clock   Full-screen worlds: a search engine, a video site, a space-weather site, a web shop, the calculator and more, each with its own hazards   A live news window reports the match, and the anchor takes sides   A new wallpaper every round, plus physics wallpapers: snow, zero gravity, water, wind and a sea breeze   Desktop extras join in: a cactus, a rubber duck, a paper plane, a weather widget and a desk pet   Dozens of physics weapons and desk props, from a sledgehammer to a recycle-bin cannon          Made for one screen and a couch   Up to five players on one PC: the mouse plus four stickmen   A slow-motion KO replay you can save as a GIF, comic end screens, Discoveries to find, hats and cursor looks   Menus and every in-game text in 13 languages   Smoother than before on busy desktops and in mouse matches   Add STICKMAN DESKTOP MALWARS to your wishlist to hear the moment it launches.

short: Five diver dials for DeskForge's desktop clock — matte black, aged bronze, forged steel, all built to be read in one glance. A second hand that sweeps instead of ticking, 85 to 1024 px, adjustable transparency, and a carousel that rotates your favourites. Requires DeskForge.
about: A tool watch on your wallpaper  Diver watches were never made to be admired politely. They were made to be read — in dark water, through a glove, in a single glance. This pack puts five of them on your desktop, keeping real time behind everything you have open, so the corner of the screen you keep glancing at finally has something worth glancing at.           Five diver faces     Abyss · Ice-Crystal Cyan  — matte black case, black-and-blue fan dial, cyan lume glowing in the dark     Tide · Ink-Blue Ripple  — black case, deep-blue wave-pattern dial, bull's-eye markers     Old Voyage · Ocean Indigo  — titanium-grey case, deep-blue dial, warm retro lume     Sunk Hull · Bronze-Rust Snowflake  — aged bronze case, blue water-wave dial, snowflake hands     Surge · Forged Spiral Blue  — forged steel case, blue spiral dial      How it lives on the desktop     The second hand sweeps.  It glides the way a mechanical movement does, instead of ticking once a second.     Any size you like.  Scale it freely, from a small watch in the corner to something that fills half the desktop. The artwork is drawn at high resolution, so it stays sharp all the way up.     Transparency from 30% to fully solid.  Sink it into the wallpaper or let it stand out.     It sits at the very back.  No taskbar entry, no Alt-Tab clutter, and clicking it never steals focus from whatever you are typing in. Works across multiple monitors.     Very light on resources  — it runs all day and you hardly notice it. And it measures itself: the tray menu shows the CPU and memory it is using at this moment, so you do not have to take our word for it.      Or let them take turns  Pick the faces you actually like and the clock rotates through them on its own — anywhere from once a minute to once every 24 hours, half an hour by default, in order or shuffled. It only ever draws from faces you already own, so the rotation is your collection rather than a catalogue of things you cannot have.    Then change the strap  A diver is not finished until it is on the right strap. The separate Watch Strap Pack adds 16 straps across leather, steel bracelet, rubber and NATO nylon, laid flat under the dial or wrapped around it in 3D, with how much strap shows adjustable from 20% up to fully extended. Rubber or NATO on a diver is the safe move; aged bronze on worn leather is the interesting one.    Other faces, other packs     Dress Dial Pack  — 5 quiet formal faces for when the desktop should just look expensive.     Pilot Dial Pack  — 5 cockpit-legible faces built around oversized numerals.     Sport Dial Pack  — 5 high-contrast faces with chronograph energy.     Vintage Dial Pack  — 8 pocket watches, lids and chains included.     Tomato Clock and Advanced Time Tools  — a Pomodoro that gets eaten as you focus, plus timer, countdown, stopwatch, alarm and a 20-zone world clock.      What you need  This is a watch-face pack for DeskForge and needs the base app. DeskForge turns a cluttered Windows desktop into somewhere you actually run your day from: drawers that hold your icons and folders, real folders opened right on the wallpaper, and live widgets like this clock.    Windows 10 (version 1903 or later) and Windows 11    Correct scaling at 100%, 125%, 150%, 175%, 200%, 250%, 300% and 400% DPI    Works across multiple monitors    Interface in English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, Russian, Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese (Portugal), German, Turkish, Thai and Vietnamese    Stored locally in SQLite — no account, no network needed    One-time purchase, no subscription

name: Astrolobe OS
lang: English
short: A game console you can walk into. Astrolobe OS is an orbital station with a desk of your own, original games including TERMINAL ORION, and a real desktop for work. Full controller support for most controllers out of the box in every game, plus 4-player split screen on games that support it.
about: A GAME CONSOLE YOU CAN WALK INTO.  High above Earth, your station is waiting.  Walk in. Sit down at your desk. The screens come alive, and your games are right there on the shelf.  Astrolobe OS is a console you live inside: an orbital station with a desk of your own, screens that wake when you sit down, and a library of original first-party games. Pick up a controller and play. Set it down and open the desktop. Come back tomorrow, and everything is exactly where you left it.  TERMINAL ORION: A ROBOT WAR ACROSS SPACE  The flagship. Fast movement, heavy machines and weapons that hit like they mean it, across more than 35 authored maps.  Tear through the arena in Drill Bots with the robot and drill you choose. Fight in team battles, free-for-all, objective modes, and a snipers-and-stickies-only mode for the sharpshooters. Survive round after round of hostile machines in Infected, from runners and crawlers to ranged threats and bosses. Go close-quarters in tight 2v2 and 3v3 Arenas with nowhere to hide. Play offline against bots any time in Skirmish, build your own battlegrounds in Forge, and set your own rules in Custom Games. Play local split-screen with up to four players in Custom Games and Infected.  Choose your first robot from a roster of 30. Climb the ranks to unlock the rest, and earn medals for the moments worth remembering. Every mode opens with a voice that tells you what's at stake.  MORE ON THE SHELF  Astrolobe is a home for every kind of game, not just one shooter. Grapple Grid is momentum arcade action: swing, chain, score and take down bosses. The House Keeps Ten is a horror anthology hiding somewhere in the station. RETE MIRABILE puts a living system in your hands, where simple rules grow into endless life. Every game sits on your shelf in its own case. Pick one up and play.  THEN GET TO WORK  Behind the games is a real desktop, not a menu dressed up as one. Open, move, resize and close real application windows. Use the Start menu, taskbar, search and system settings. Work with files and folders, Notes, and a built-in command shell. Make it yours with themes, wallpapers and layouts for every screen from 4:3 to super-ultrawide. Use a controller, or mouse and keyboard. Sit at a single-screen desk, or a three-screen Creator Station overlooking Earth.  UNDER THE HOOD: A CONSOLE THAT KEEPS TRACK OF ITSELF  Most launchers are a picture of a computer. Astrolobe OS has a real one underneath.  Nothing is silently lost. Every change to your files is checked before it lands, and out-of-date or conflicting actions are refused instead of quietly overwriting your work. Everything is on record: each change produces a receipt of what was asked, whether it went through, and exactly what changed. And it can prove its own history. The system can replay a run of events from the same starting point and confirm it arrives at exactly the same state.  For the curious: a Python kernel owns the console's internal model, covering programs, windows, focus, files, settings and session state. The station and desktop you see are rendered in Godot as a view of that model. Changes run as governed commands, are committed or rejected, and are recorded in a SQLite-backed authority with SHA-256-hashed receipts. Generation checks stop stale commands from overwriting newer state, and ordered event records support deterministic replay verified by state hashes.  Astrolobe OS runs on Windows as an application. It does not replace Windows and has no free run of your PC. Anything it touches on your machine goes through specific, permissioned interfaces.  IN DEVELOPMENT  We'd rather tell you straight than oversell it. These are being built now and are not promised for day one: online multiplayer for TERMINAL ORION, arriving as a beta; Astrolobe Browser, for real websites right on your desktop; the Command Center, a shared online space of ten offices around a twelve-screen central room; ORION ZERO, where the story begins as a machine smaller than a bug wakin

name: OLED Guard Pro
lang: English, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Dutch, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish, Persian
short: Prevent OLED burn-in with adaptive overlays that track static pixels in real time. Works in borderless fullscreen games, multi-monitor setups, and lets you create custom protection presets for work, gaming, or media.
about: Protect the pixels that stay still       Adaptive OLED protection for work, gaming, and multi-monitor PCs.       Taskbars, browser controls, editing panels, dashboards, and game HUDs can remain unchanged for hours, causing some  OLED pixels to age faster than others.       OLED Guard Pro  analyzes brightness, motion, stability, and exposure over time. As risk builds, it gradually   dims the affected areas. When the content changes, visible protection releases promptly instead of lingering over the   new scene.      Use one simple Intensity control and let Autopilot handle the rest, or open the advanced controls and tune the   engine yourself.      Protection that adapts — and lets go           OLED Guard separates how quickly protection builds from how quickly obsolete protection disappears.         Relaxed  waits for content to remain static for a long time.     Balanced  provides natural timing for everyday work and slower games.     Responsive  protects persistent elements faster.     Auto  selects a tier from the current activity and tells you what it chose and why.        Changing Responsiveness does not make old protection remain on changed content. Every tier is designed to release   promptly when the protected shape is no longer present.      Built for borderless fullscreen gaming              OLED Guard Pro continues operating over windowed and borderless fullscreen games without injecting code into the   game or modifying its rendering engine.       Game IQ (Beta)  learns where each game places persistent HUD elements such as health bars, minimaps, scores,   and ability icons.                HUD layouts are learned separately for each game.    Recognized HUDs remain protected during controller play, spectating, pauses, and hands-off moments.    The current screen is checked before remembered protection is displayed, so an old score, message, or HUD shape  does not remain over a menu, replay, or replacement scene.    Learning and saved HUD regions remain local to your PC.        Choose  Gaming — Fast  for multiplayer and esports, or  Gaming — Slow  for RPGs, strategy games, and   longer cinematic sessions. Autopilot can choose automatically.               Compatibility note:  Windowed and borderless fullscreen games are supported. A true legacy exclusive-fullscreen game cannot display a Windows overlay; OLED Guard detects that state, pauses presentation, and resumes when  the game returns to a composited mode.      Six presets for different kinds of content         Gaming — Fast      Gaming — Slow      Media      Work / Browsing / Coding      Creative / Design      Dashboard / Monitoring         App Profiles can automatically activate a preset and optional Intensity override whenever a selected application   becomes active. Pick an installed Steam game, a running application, or any executable on your PC.      Focused-app behavior is one clear choice: let protection  Follow mode ,  Keep the focused app clear , or   Protect it fully .      Independent multi-monitor protection           Every connected display receives its own capture, exposure history, and protection state. You can enable or disable   protection separately for each monitor without disturbing the others.      OLED Guard supports modern desktop configurations including HDR, high-refresh displays, G-Sync and FreeSync, mixed-DPI layouts, docking, and monitor hot-plugging.      Away Mode goes further while you are gone      After a configurable idle period, Away Mode applies a deep, uniform overlay dim.      If a monitor supports DDC/CI brightness control, OLED Guard can also lower its hardware brightness to 20% of that   monitor’s range. It never raises a display that is already dimmer, and restores each monitor’s exact previous value   when you return or quit.      Restore information is saved before brightness changes, allowing OLED Guard to recover the original level after an   interrupted session or restart.      Choose how protection looks

name: Verdant Requiem Demo
lang: Japanese, English
short: “SRPG in Search of Balance" On a continent where three nations’ ideals clash, what will you choose, and what will you protect? Verdant Requiem is a SRPG about a war for balance beyond good and evil, featuring detailed 2D maps, branching storylines, resource management, and elemental balance.
about: This is the demo version of Verdant Requiem.  If you play through the game at normal speed without skipping cutscenes or using auto-play, it should take about 6 to 8 hours.（depending on your reading speed and how you play the game.）  The Steam Deck is not supported.  Because the demo version uses a different internal ID and application structure from the full version, save data transfer to the full version and compatibility with achievements or other related data are not guaranteed.  This demo is provided so that players can experience the atmosphere and early gameplay of Verdant Requiem before considering the full version. Thank you for your understanding.  ＊Also considering localizing both the demo and the full version into English in the future.  SRPG in Search of Balance  On a continent where the ideals of three nations clash, what will you choose, and what will you defend?       “Verdant Requiem” is a scenario-driven SRPG that combines classic tactical gameplay with epic, war-chronicle-style scenarios, branching narratives, and a unique military management system.  This is not a story where good and evil are simply divided. Resources, faith, military power, and national ambitions—as the ideals and contradictions held by each nation clash, the protagonist Leonis and his companions are drawn into a battle for the balance of the continent.  The fate of this continent rests entirely on your choices.    Long-Form Scenario SRPG  This title is a long-form SRPG designed to offer over 40 hours of gameplay, including in-game time and free scenarios.  The story features branching paths, with each route taking approximately 12 to 17 hours to complete. Depending on the path you choose, the portrayal of nations, the positions of your allies, and the ending will all change.    In the demo version, you can play up to the point where the story branches. (Up to the ending of Chapter 9)    In addition to the main scenario, free scenarios are also available, allowing you to enjoy the ensemble drama through flashback events told from each character’s perspective.  While there is no permanent character loss, penalties for injuries do exist. Rather than irreversible loss, we aimed to balance tension and playability by ensuring the results of battle remain within your army.    Classic Tactical System            The combat in this game emphasizes the tactical depth of classic SRPGs.  In addition to basic strategic elements like the rock-paper-scissors weapon system, special attacks, and skills, we’ve implemented a follow-up attack system triggered by flanking maneuvers based on positioning, as well as a combat skill system that leverages each character’s unique traits.  It’s not just about defeating enemies—it’s about deciding which unit to place where, who to have initiate the attack, and when to use combat skills. We aimed to create battles true to the SRPG genre, where every single decision changes the course of the battle.    A War-Themed Fantasy Focused on Story  “Verdant Requiem” is not your typical fantasy tale of good versus evil, but rather a war-themed story where the ideals and conspiracies of various nations intertwine.  At the heart of the story lies the balance among three nations: a nation rich in resources, a nation driven by faith, and a nation built on trade and scholarship. The circumstances each faces are far from simple, and even their adversaries have reasons they cannot compromise on.  While the story primarily follows Leonis as the protagonist, free scenarios and flashback events also shine a spotlight on his companions and figures from each nation. To ensure that no character is overshadowed, the number of ally units has been designed to be slightly smaller than in conventional SRPG titles.  In exchange, we place great emphasis on carefully depicting each character’s background, stance, and relationships. short: Virtual pet on your desktop! Drag it with the mouse, grow crops, mine resources, craft and trade. Take care of your pet’s needs and use the built-in timer. A living world of adventures on top of all applications!
about: ✨ Turn your desktop into a living world of adventure! ✨  Meet your new digital companion who will live right on your desktop! Your pet is not just an animation, but a full-fledged character with its own needs and desires.      🐾 Drag your pet across the screen:   You can pick up your pet with the mouse and drag it anywhere on the screen. It will walk across the Start menu, explore the desktop, and slide down the edges of the screen.             🌱 Grow food:   The pet can plant, water, and harvest crops. All you need is to place a plot for planting and throw in a seed, after which your pet will plant and harvest everything on its own. Watering plants only works if there is water in the inventory, which must be collected in advance from the well.             ⛏️ Mine resources:   Your pet can mine various resources in special mines. You can sell these resources in the market for coins or, with the right equipment, process them, create different tools and materials, and sell them for even more.             💰 Trade:   You can sell all the vegetables you grow and resources you mine in the market for money, which you will need to buy crafting machines, seeds, gifts, and more. You can also make deals with merchants in exchange for certain resources.             💖 Take care of your pet:   Your pet has needs such as hunger, thirst, fatigue, and mood. Monitor all needs to keep your pet happy. With a bad mood or low level of any need, it will refuse to work. If you neglect your pet, it will leave you.             📦 Resource management:   In the game, you will encounter many different resources and crafting. All items on the desktop can be moved and rearranged using the mouse. Your pet can also help you with this, clearing the desktop of unnecessary resources.             ⏰ Built-in timer   To increase the multifunctionality of the game, a clock with a timer was added.  You can set a timer for up to 60 hours. And you don’t need to keep it on the desktop. Just set it and hide it in the inventory. If the timer expires while it’s on the desktop, it will start ringing; if it’s in the inventory, your pet will take it out and notify you that the time is up. Measure time for work, rest, or play.               🔧 Features:   Works on top of all applications  Automatic progress saving  Does not interfere with regular computer work  Pawoki: Desktop Pets is the perfect way to add a little joy and life to your workday. Your digital friend is always nearby, ready to cheer you up and keep you company!  Download now and start an amazing journey with your new pet!

short: A hand-drawn papercut desktop pet with blind-box collecting and Pomodoro focus. A fridge-bellied grandpa and a big-mouthed cow cat live in your screen corner
about: ICEman  is a hand-crafted paper-collage desktop pet, blind-box collector, and Pomodoro companion. Living right on the edge of your screen are a quirky grandpa whose torso is a vintage refrigerator and his tuxedo cat with a magical mouth full of retro surprises. Boop the cat's nose to roll blind-box tokens, merge three-of-a-kind to unlock new animations, and trigger hilarious retro performances while you work or relax!

short: Tiny Desktop Birds is a cozy desktop companion game where cute little birds fly across your Windows desktop, perch on app windows, rest near videos, and quietly keep you company while you work, study, browse, or relax.
about: A tiny flock living on your desktop   Tiny Desktop Birds  is a relaxing desktop companion game where little birds fly across your Windows desktop and gently become part of your daily screen life.  They may perch on application windows, rest near your video player, wander around your workspace, or simply fly by while you are working, studying, browsing, or taking a break. Relax, watch, and enjoy  There are no battles, no pressure, and no complicated goals. Tiny Desktop Birds is designed to be a cozy, peaceful experience that stays with you in the background — like a small flock of living decorations on your desktop.  Watch them fly, land, idle, and interact with your screen in subtle ways. Sometimes they gather together. Sometimes one little bird quietly stays beside your window. They are here to make your desktop feel a little warmer, softer, and more alive. Features    A cozy desktop companion experience   Little birds that fly around and perch on your desktop windows   Relaxing, low-pressure gameplay   Cute hand-drawn bird animations   Designed to run alongside your daily work, study, browsing, or video watching   A peaceful atmosphere for players who enjoy desktop pets, cozy games, and tiny living companions   Let these tiny birds bring a bit of nature, calmness, and charm to your everyday desktop.
